hymns.title: BADI BASUE LUPANDU

versions.title: BADI BASUE LUPANDU

lines: Badi basue lupandu balue kudi yesu bonso bapete muoyo,
bakupibue mena ku mukanda wa lufu bonso bapete moyo.
Luaku wewe muntu muteketa ku Di, luaku upete muoyo,
yesu udi ukubikila uye nandi luaku usungidibue.
Yesu udi wela tshiondo ukubikila luaku upete muoyo,
udi ukutangila misangu isatu kayi ukudimuka.
buela, buela, buela, buela: buela, buela, yesu udi ukubikila.

hymns.title: LUAYI KUDI YESU

versions.title: LUAYI KUDI YESU

lines: Luayi kudi yesu, luayi lubilu wakatuleja njila wa muoyo,
udi muimane apa mpidieu utuambila luayi.
Bantu bonso balue kudiye, mitshima yabo isankabe,
tumuitabuja anu yeye katuindidi tuyayi.
Tuye kudiye tuetu mene, yesu udi utubikila,
bituapidia lufu kashidi, katuindidi tuyayi.
disanka, disanka dinene nedikale kulu kua NZ wa muoyo
patuamonangana ne yesu ku musoko wandi.

hymns.title: PAKAKUATA NZAMBI MUDIMU WAKUFUKA NE KUENZA

versions.title: PAKAKUATA NZAMBI MUDIMU WAKUFUKA NE KUENZA

lines: Pakakuata NZ mudimu wa kufuka ne kuenza diulu dia kafukibua,
buloba bua kafukibua, «buloba kabuakadi ne tshintu anu mai ke akadi pa buloba»
NZ kololayi tshianza kumisha mai pa buloba,
«buloba kushala anu buloba midima yonso yakajika»
Buloba wetu buloba wamanya kushadi anu buloba
«uvuijibue mukuna wangata lupandu lua kashidi»
NZ wanyi : «ne bafunde dina dianyi ku mukanda wa moyo»
«bua binsonji ne muadi kabitshiena ne bualu»

hymns.title: KALE KU TSHIBANGIDILU NZAMBI WAKAFUKA

versions.title: KALE KU TSHIBANGIDILU NZAMBI WAKAFUKA

lines: Kale ku tshibangidilu Nzambi wakafuka diulu ne buloba ne mayi manene yaweh an " nyuma wa Nzambi wakadi unyungula pa muntu pa mayi."
Tumukayi pa buloba tuendeleya pa muntu pa mayi, netubande mu diulu mu Nzambi tatu, Nzambi wa ba moyo,
" buloba budi mubidi, diulu didi nyuma wa Nzambi, mayi mayisha a Nzambi, munya dimanya yoyoyo midima idi dipanga"
Nzambi wa katapulula munya ne midima, munya ne munya midima ne butuku, yaweh an " wewa tatu (mamu) eu udi munya etshi udi midima "
Buloba bua kamenesha bimenyi bionso midioko ne mitshi, mamuma ne nteta yaweh an " bana ba Nzambi tukuamayi mamuma a buakana "
Nzambi wakafuka bintu bidi ne moyo ; nyama ne nyunyi, minyinyi mu mayi yaweh an, " muntu wakadi nfumu wa bintu bionso ebi "
tuelayi Nzambi tuasankidila Nzambi eyo Nzambi wa ba moyo (bis)

hymns.title: NZAMBI WAKELA MEJI BUA KUFUKA

versions.title: NZAMBI WAKELA MEJI BUA KUFUKA

lines: Nzambi wakela meji bua kufuka diulu ne buloba
kusangana midima mibuikile pa mutu pa buloba
«kukuataye mudimu wa kutemesha kua munya »
NZ wakatapulula munya ne midima
«kusungula dinda ne dilolo kuteka malu pa buloba»
Nakatangila kumona muanjelo upueka, uvua ne dina difunda mu mpala muandi,
uvua ne bantu tshishikula tshimue ne mbombo inai
«ne binunu binai ke nomba wa diulu»
«yehowa wanyi : bua kumona munya witabuja Di”,”ne umbuka mu dikenga ne ubuela mu disanka”

hymns.title: NZAMBI WANYI WAKAFUKA DIULU

versions.title: NZAMBI WANYI WAKAFUKA DIULU

lines: NZ wanyi wakafuka diulu, kufuka buloba, kufuka ne mai manene, kunfuka ne meme.
Tumbushayi bukoya mu mioyo tuambulayi mutshi tulondayi mufuki wa bionso yesu muana NZ.
Bena NZ tudi anu bu diba, mitoto mu diulu tuimba tutumbisha mufuki dinda ne dilolo.
Mose wamanya:"buloba budi muimana mbua tshijila, buloba bua yehowa"

hymns.title: NZAMBI WAKATUFUKA MU TSHINFUANYI TSHIENDE

versions.title: NZAMBI WAKATUFUKA MU TSHINFUANYI TSHIENDE

lines: NZ wakatufuka mu tshinfunyi tshiende, muntu mumana kufukibua,
wakateka bidi bikenka mulu mua diulu, wakateka diba diodi bua kukokesha munya,
wakateka ngondo mitoto bua kukokesha butuku.
Wewe muanetu wanyi mu yesu udi uzakajibua bua tshinyi?
diba diteka mu wewe,ngondo muteka mu wewe ne mitoto miteka mu wewe
bua butumbi bua NZ wetu:"udi uzakajibua bua tshinyi ne malu apa buloba"
"Bakumana kupula nzubu muasa ne bianza",
"lelu badi bibaka nzubu mu nyuma wa NZ",
"bua kumuenesha buakana mu bantu ba pa buloba"
wewe muanetu :"udi uzakajibua bua tshinyi ne malu apa buloba?"
Commentaires

hymns.title: KALE KU TSHIBANGIDILU DȊ DIA NZAMBI DIAKADI

versions.title: KALE KU TSHIBANGIDILU DȊ DIA NZAMBI DIAKADI

lines: Kale ku tshibangidilu dî dia Nzambi diakadî diakamba nefuka muntu ne tshifuanyi tshia nyuma yoyoyo " ikale bu mukalenga mu bintu binakafuka "(bis)
Mona Adama ne Eva kupidiabu di dia moyo diakadi mukanshi muabo ekunyemabo lubilu "ikale bu mukalenga mu bintu binakafuka "(bis)
Mona nyunyi ya mu diulu ituyimba ne disanka itumbisha wa misumba kadi tuetu bana bende, kadi tuetu bana bende netuimbile nganyi mukuabu (yoyiwe)
" ikale bu mukalenga mu bintu binakafuka" (bis)

hymns.title: PAKAJIKIJA NZAMBI KUFUKA BINTU

versions.title: PAKAJIKIJA NZAMBI KUFUKA BINTU

lines: Pakajikija NZ kufuka bintu, wakela meji bua kufuka muntu ne tshinfuanyikiji tshia NZ tatu
« mufuanangane ne NZ »
Bua kutulejaye bumuntu buende wakamueneka kudi Moise, kutuma yesu bu muntu nunku
« mu mubidi wa bukoya »
Wananga muntu wakutangilaye, munanga NZ udiye kayi mutangila,
bua NZ kena ne mubidi bu wa muntu, na mumona diba kayi anu dia kunshikidilu.
Nzambikudifuka mu mubidi bu muntu,kuenzaye buloba kuelaye muhuya wa muoyo
muntu kuimanaye papa ekutangilaye NZ,kamanyi kua kufumaye ne tshivuaye wenza nansha,
NZ kubikila muntu ne muntu kumuitabaye,
« muntu kuenda tunku yeye kusankaye, ne banjelo ba mu diulu bakasankila mu muntu,
bakimba batumbisha NZ yehowa mufuki wetu »

hymns.title: KU KALE KU KALE NZAMBI KUFUKA

versions.title: KU KALE KU KALE NZAMBI KUFUKA

lines: ku kale ku kale Nzambi kufuka muntu mulume ne mukadi wandi yeye wakabateka mu budimi, budimi bua Edena (bis)
(Nzambi kuela mukeriji) Nzambi kuela mukeriji wamba ne nudie mamuma onso " kadi mutshi idi mutshi idi muktanshi mua budimi binuadia nudi nufue "
Pakadi Adama wenda mu budimi pakapinganaye ku nzubu wandi satana mumana kuteya Eva mudia tshimuma tshibi (bis)
pakadi Nzambi wenda mu budimi pakuvuabo diyi dia Nzambi wabo bakanyema lubilu basokoma bua bakadi butaka (bis)
Nenu bantu aba, nenu nuakuya kudi kunyi ? nenu nuakuya muaba kayi ?
Adama kuitaba " satana wa kututeya tuakudia ne tukadi butaka" (bis)

hymns.title: MUKAJI WAKADIA TSHIMUMA

versions.title: MUKAJI WAKADIA TSHIMUMA

lines: Mukaji wakadia tshimuma ku mashimi a satana, wakaya nathi tshikuata ku bianza bua kupa muluma wandi,
« bua kupanga kua bukokeshi muluma wakangata wadia biandi »
Pakadi NZ wendakana mu budimi mu dilolo, wakela lubila lukole wenda ubikila Adama:
Adama, Adama, Adama udi kuepi?
“nakunvua lubila tatu meme ndi musokome”
Yehowa wakela mulau bua bupidia bua muluma: muluma ne atuka luanga ha mpala bua kupetaye tshia kudia.
Mukaji ne adinyenge bua kulela kua bana.
»nyoka munene wa mashimi ne bamudiata ku mutu »
aleluya dikenga: “nakubikila muntu wa pa buloba ne tatu”,
”nyoka ku tulelayi ku mashimi ne tuakulua bana bandi “
NZ kutuipataye mu budimi lelu tukadi tukenga, “nsunsunsu bibidi”

hymns.title: NZAMBI MUNENE WAKAFUKA BANTU ABA BABIDI

versions.title: NZAMBI MUNENE WAKAFUKA BANTU ABA BABIDI

lines: NZ munene wakafuka bantu aba babidi bua kumuenzelabo mudimu pa buloba mene e.
Nyoka munene wakadinga Eva, udia tshimuma ne ufuka bieba bantu aba bu NZ mene e.
NZ munene wakambila Adama, mukudia kuebe luanga ne lupatuke pa mpala pebe mene e.
NZ munene wakambila Eva, mu kulela kueba ne udila ne udinyenga bikole mene e.

hymns.title: ADAMA WAKAMANYANGANA NI EVA

versions.title: ADAMA WAKAMANYANGANA NI EVA

lines: Adama wakamanyangana ni eva mukaji wandi “wakalela Kana ne Ebelo”,
« kana tshidima yoyoyi we ebelo mulami wa mikoko »
Yehowa wakitabuja mulambu wa Ebelo« wakapidia mulambu wa Kana »
« kana wakabungama wakunvua tshiji »
Tuetu bena kilisto tupidiayi kana, »tushala ne ebelo buakana bua NZ »
« netupeta muoyo wakashidi »
wewe muanetu mu kilisto udi kana bubi bua bantu anyi « eshi udi Ebelo buakana bua NZ »
“ne ulambula mikoko anyi bimenyi bia pa buloba”

hymns.title: ADAMA NE EVA BAKAPIDIA NZAMBI

versions.title: ADAMA NE EVA BAKAPIDIA NZAMBI

lines: Adama ne Eva bakapidia NZ wabo makenga akabakuata.
Nfumu yesu muana NZ wakalua pa buloba bua kupikulaye bantu.
Udikonka wewa lelu ku luseka ludi wewa lua bunji anyi lua mikoko.
wewe mubengi wa NZ udikonke ku luseka luudi wewa.

hymns.title: ADAMA WAKADI NE BANA BABIDI

versions.title: ADAMA WAKADI NE BANA BABIDI

lines: Adama wakadi ne bana babidi, mukulumpa kana wakadi tshidima,”muakunyi Ebelo mulami wa mikoko”
Dinga dituku kana ne ebelo bakaya ne milambu yabo kudi NZ,”mulambu wa ebelo wakitabujibua”
“Telejayi tshiakiudi tshia mufuki nuenu bananga” bikala kana musombuedibue misangu muanda mutekete,
”ikala kundi makumi muanda muteketa ne muanda muteketa”
Bananga tulama Di tulekela lukinu”katulu kukengeshibua bua kumona kua malu a bantu”,
”Kana muena tshiendenda: wakatambakana bua kumona kua malu a bantu”

hymns.title: BUALU BUA MILAMBU

versions.title: BUALU BUA MILAMBU

lines: Bualu bua milambu bu bangila ku tshibangidilu, kana wakalambula bintu biakamena mu budimi, Ebelo wakalambula muana buta wa mikoko ne dianyi.
NZ wakakonka kana muakunyeba Ebelo udi penyi, Kana wakamuandamuna mema tshiena mulami wa muakunyanyi.
Kana wakanyema wakasokoma ku mesu kua yehowa, kana wakalomba yehowa muntu yonso wamusangana a mushipa.
lambulayi mikoko Ebelo ikala ne moyo, lekelayi ku lambula milambu yenu mu mubidi,
tshiunvuidi tshienu tshia mubidi ekushipa Ebelo, bonso buenu nudi Kana.

hymns.title: LEMEKA WAKADI NE BIDIMU BIA BUNYI

versions.title: LEMEKA WAKADI NE BIDIMU BIA BUNYI

lines: Lemeka wakadi ne bidimu bia bunyi wakalela muana dina diende Noa,"bualu wakatshina Nzambi ku malu mabi " (bis)
Buloba bunyaguke ne malu, buloba bula neta ne majitu bantu banyanguka ne makalenga a panshi,
"lua undeja njila njila muimpe njila wa moyo" (bis)
Eku kulondolola kua malu a Noa wakadi ne bana basatu mu nzubu muandi, " kudi shema ne Yama ne Yafeta " (bis)
Pakamona Nzambi ne bantu bonso bakatomboka, mudimu onso wakunyanguka, wakalokesha nvulu wa matuku makumi anayi
" bua kutshipa ngenyi ya bantu ivua minyanguke (mitomboka) " (bis)

hymns.title: PAKABANGA BANTU KUVULANGANA

versions.title: PAKABANGA BANTU KUVULANGANA

lines: Pakabanga bantu kuvulangana ba bungi pa buloba, bansongalume ba bantu ba NZ pakamonabo bansongakaji ba bantu ba tshianana
« bakasungula bakasuabo bu bakaji babo »
Mu matuku a bantu banunu ne bantu ba nfiondo, bansongalume ba bantu ba NZ bakalela bana
«ne bantu ba tshiana ne bantu ba pa buloba»
Nuenu bana betu bonso bakayila nyuma kanusu malu a pa buloba ne nyenyi yonso ya panshi
« ya bantu ba tshianana, ya bantu ba pa buloba »
bulelela kayi ? Pankatshi pa muntu wa NZ ne bantu ba tshianana biasua muntu malu apa buloba ne avuija lukuna ne nyuma,
nyuma wa NZ ke wa badi pa buloba, nyuma tshieya tshidi munda muetu, kena usengelela bantu
« kanunyingalaji nyuma muimpe wa NZ »

hymns.title: PAKAVULANGANA BUBI

versions.title: PAKAVULANGANA BUBI

lines: Pakavulangana bubi, pakela bantu meji mabi pa buloba, Nzambi wakanyingalala bua kujimijaye "buloba, bantu ne bintu".
Wakambila Noa ndaku usonga buatu " nejimije buloba, bantu ne bintu", " mutshima wakunyingalala bua nakabifuka".
" Buatu budi bulongolol abuamunt uy onsoal uekubuel amu", " buakuepuka kunvula idi ishibeya bantu, nekuenzela Nzambi mudimu bunkutshi".(bis)
Nvula yakaloka mingi matuku makumi anai pa buloba. Noa mu buatu ne bantu ba mu nzubu muandi " ne bintu, nyama ne nyunyi".
Pakajika nvula Noa kupatukaye mu buatu" kujadika tshipungidi ne Yehowa": " muanza nkongolo tshimanyinu tshia tshipungidi".
Nvula munene udiku, Noa ne buatu bidiku pa buloba. Bua kubatiza amu bantu kabafu mu mai,"tshinfuanyi tshia adi atusungila".
Dibatiza ki diuvuwa dia manyanu a mubibi, "kadi bua dikeba dia muoyo mukese" " muimpe kudi Nzambi buadi bikadi a Kilisto".

hymns.title: TSHIKONDO TSHIA KALE NAKADI MU MIDIMA

versions.title: TSHIKONDO TSHIA KALE NAKADI MU MIDIMA

lines: Tshikondo tshia kale nakadi mu midima "lelu munya wa kulua kudi muntu yonso"(bis)
Noa wakenza buatu nyama ne nyunyi ne bintu bionso "biakabuela, biakabuela, biakabuela mu buatu" (bis)
Nzambi wakatuma Noa bua kusonga meme " bua bueja bantu ne bintu bionso bindinabi"(bis)
" Ngimbila nganyi misambu bua disanka didinandi " " nyoka ne ngandu mbuji ne ngomba biapethsi moyo "(bis)

hymns.title: TUAKUMANA KUENDA MU MIDIMA

versions.title: TUAKUMANA KUENDA MU MIDIMA

lines: Tuakumana kuenda mu midima "lelu munya wa kutema mu mitshima ya bantu" Yepowa Nzambi kutuma muntu muimpa Noa ne
buloba bunyanguke nejimije buloba , Noa songa buatu nebutule bantu (bis)
(dia lelu) Nensonge buatu nengambe lumu mu miaku yonso mu Nzubu yonso kudi muntu yonso pa buloba bujima (bis)
Munya mumanya kutema mu midima "Nzambi wa katuma Mose kudi Palo" "bua angata Izalele aya nandi mu Kanana, bua angata bantu bandi baya biabu mu tshipela" (bis)
Mosa wamana kupangile mu tshipela "Yoshua muana wa Nuna wakamuenenka" "bua angata Izalele aya nenda mu Kanana, bua angata bantu bandi aya nabu mu tshipela" (bis)

hymns.title: NOA MU BUATU

versions.title: NOA MU BUATU

lines: “Noa mu buatu kutumayi tshikololo, ndaku ukateta mai ne apueki pa buloba”, monayi:
“tshikololo kupatuka, mona tshitume tshaiyla tshaiya kasomba, tshiashala tshilembelela, katshiyi tshisua kupingana”.
“Noa ne tshiji tshia bualu bua tshikololo, Noa kutumaye nyunyi kayi? Noa kutumaye nkutshi”.
“monayi: Nkutshi kupatuka kuya ujadikile wapingana kudi Noa ne tshisala tshitshibula, wakajikija mudimu”
“Adama ni Eva monayi bakapambuka, NZ wetu yeya nabo bobo kubengabo muoyo”.
“Monayi:bantu bedibue maluu bua bupidia buabo bu muambidila NZ bakalengulula muoyo, makenga eku balonda”
“Wewa ne mema batumibue bua mudimu, kondopa mioyo ya bantu”,
”monayi: NZ kutupa mudimu kadi tuwenji anyi eshi tuafulu nau bu muakenza tshikololo, tshiashala tshilembelela, katshiyi tshisua kupingana »
“Wayiyoyi wayiyoyi badi balala bikaye, tuetu bakadi ke bakadi bana ba NZ wa muoyo”,
”nuyaya netu anyi eshi nudi balala, bikayi nupeta muoyo, muoyo ne yesu mu duilu”

hymns.title: NZAMBI WAKABIKILA ABALAMA

versions.title: NZAMBI WAKABIKILA ABALAMA

lines: “NZ wakabikila Abalama”,
“ wakamuitaba ne ndiku meme yehowa NZ”,
“wakalopoka ne Lota mu üla ne Salai.”
“Abalama wakadi ne bubanji bua bungi”,
“Lota wakadi ne buende bubanji muaba wakadi mukese”,
“bua bobo kushikama bonso we mu muaba umue”.
“Abalama wakambila Lota utapuluka kundi”
Lota biwaya ku dia balume meme nyaya ku diabakaji, Lota biwaya ku dia bakaji meme nyaya ku dia balume,
”ndi muntu wa NZ Lota utapuluka kundi”
”Nakulopoka ne Salai mu üla”,
« lelu nakupeta Sala muledi wa badi ne muoyo »,
«ndi munda mua tatu, tatu munda muanyi »

hymns.title: PAKUNVUA ABALAMA DÎ DIMUBIKILA

versions.title: PAKUNVUA ABALAMA DÎ DIMUBIKILA

lines: " Pakunvua Abalama dî dimubikila","wakalonda dî Di, wakalonda Nzambi wa muoyo"(bis)
" Nsankayi bua Nzambi bua tuetu tupidia malu mabi".
"nsankayi bua Yesu bua tuetu tuamba Di mu bantu"." nsankayi bua nyuma bua tuetu tupeta muoyo" (bis)
" Pakamba diba kubuela tulu tukole tuakamukuata","wakunvua bowa bua bubi buvua munda muenda"(bis)
"Bua muntu yonso wapunga ne Nzambi wende tshipungidi","ajadika tshipungidi ne muntu nende""( netupiana buloba)x3 kumusulu wa pelata"(bis)

hymns.title: ABALAMA KUNVUA DI DIA NZAMBI WA MUOYO

versions.title: ABALAMA KUNVUA DI DIA NZAMBI WA MUOYO

lines: Abalama kunvua Di dia NZ wa muoyo umbuka mu tshiota tshiebe mudi tatu ‘eba,
« tangila mitoto mulu ne wa ibala, tangila nsenga ya buloba ne wa ibala,
ne kuvuija tshisamba tshinene Abalama, ooo Abalama »
Buakupeta muana, muana mupianyi wa bintu anu mbuji, ngomba, mikoko mipanda nseka;
biwapanda nyunyi nseka nyama mijima, Elieza muena damaseka udi pa buipi bua kupiana bintu bivua muana
ne bua kupiana ooo Elieza .
Muana eu udi muena budishikaminyi kena bu muana mupika wa kusinai,
« udi muana mulya wakalaya NZ, NZ kutulaya muoyo wa tshiendelela
bua tuetu kupiana diulu ne masanka onso ooo a kashidi »
Abalama wakapanda mbuji ne ngomba ne mikoko, nyunyi wa nkutshi ne mputu nyunyi kakapanda;
wewe muanetu mu njila emu udi ne ngomba,wewe muanetu mu njila emu udi ne mbuji,
wewe muanetu mu njila emu udi ne mikoko,kadi nyunyi wa nkutshi ne mputu nyunyi udi mupanda.
Abalama wakapanda mbuji ne ngomba ne mikoko,nyunyi wa nkutshi ne mputu nyunyi kakapanda.

hymns.title: NZAMBI WAKATUMA BANTU KUDI ABALAHAMA

versions.title: NZAMBI WAKATUMA BANTU KUDI ABALAHAMA

lines: NZ wakatuma bantu kudi Abalama, ndayi nu muambila ne Sala ne alela.
Nunku pakashala Sala yeye wakimita difu, pakapingana yehowa Sala wakalela.
Ebu bukole bua NZ buakalejayi bantu bua mukaji eu mununu wakalela muana.
«Sala kuseka eyi eyi »
« meme ndi muntu mununu Sala ne ndela munyi ? »

hymns.title: BANTU BA SODOMA NE AMOLA

versions.title: BANTU BA SODOMA NE AMOLA

lines: Bantu ba sodoma ne amola bakapidia NZ, NZ wabo wa disanka wa luse we eyo.
Wewe tatu, wewe mamu, wewe nsongalume biwakala mu sodomo ne ushipibue bushua.
Wewe muambi wa NZ tumbisha NZ webe, biwaluja meji panyima neulue dibue dia luehu.
NZ wakamba:ne ngosha sodomo, ne ngosha amola, sodomo ne amola bakapidia NZ.

hymns.title: BANJELO BAKAYA BUA KUSUNGILA LOTA

versions.title: BANJELO BAKAYA BUA KUSUNGILA LOTA

lines: Banjelo bakaya bua kusungila Lota apatuka mu sodomo mu masanka a panshi,
«apatuka mu dikenga abuele mu disanka »,
« muadi newikalaku ne kusumakaja kua menu »
Lota wakabambila luayi munemu balunda « nubuela mu nzubu emu, nulalamu butuku »,

lines: Bena isalela bakadi ne Mose kubenga yehowa kulonda bala «nzambi wa bisamba biabende kabayi mua kumanya »
Nuena bana betu nubenga bua nyuma, nupidia Di «bananga mianda ne maluba biobio kabiyi ne difutu»
NZ wa misumba mubenga midima, muanyisha munya « munyoka badi ne mahaha kabayi ne mesu nansha »

tudi basomba mu nkuasa lelu,tudi bakuata dikombo dia bukalenga.

hymns.title: YOSHUA WA KATUMA BATENTEKEDI

versions.title: YOSHUA WA KATUMA BATENTEKEDI

lines: Yoshua wakatuma batentekedi bua kutentekela buloba ne Yeleko, baka buela mu nzubu wa mukaji muena tshiendenda dina diandi Lahaba bakalalamu.bis
bena Isalela babuediwe mu buloba buetu, ndayi nuka bapatule mu buloba buetu, nubalonda ne ku mikuna nukabashipelaku.bis
Nuenu batentekedi nusungile tatu wanyi ne mamu wanyi ne bana betu, nusungile mioyo yetu ku lufu mene, numpesha tshieya tshilelela bu mitshihu yenu.bis
Balume aba baka muambila ne netufila mioyo yetu bua kukufuila biwikale kuyi musokolola bualu buetu ebu patupa Yehowa buloba ne tukuenzela malu a luse ne abushuwa. (bis)

hymns.title: BENA ISALELA BASABUKA YADENA LELU

versions.title: BENA ISALELA BASABUKA YADENA LELU

lines: “Bena isalela basabuka yadena lelu (an eyowe)”;
“tshina musheta londa musheta panyima(an eyowe)”;
“shila musheta muaba pankatshi coude binunu bibidi(an eyowe)”.
“Buakusabuka yadena nuimane balulama mu yadena (an eyowe)”,
“muntu ne muntu ambula dibua dienda mu yadena”,
“tuyaya kuluangana nvita ne yeleko(an eyowe)”.
“Bakuidi batuala musheta wa tshipungidi tshia mei a yehowa (an eyowe)”;
“kimana balulama mu lusenga luma mu yadena (an eyowe)”,
“bonso basabuka mu lusenga luma ku makasa (an eyowe)”.
waya katonkola dieba dibue ne ukonka nganyi tatu waniywe,
dibue diashadi bu mumanyi wa bualu pankatshi petu neba we, Yoshua wimanyiki dibue bu mutshi wa telebinta.

hymns.title: NDI MONA MUKALENGA MU MUOYO WANYI

versions.title: NDI MONA MUKALENGA MU MUOYO WANYI

lines: Ndi mona mukalenga mu muoyo wanyi, bualu Di diandi didi munda muanyi.
Lahaba muena tshiendeda wakasungidibue bualu wakasokoka batentekedi.
Bua kubuela mu kanana tudilengejayi, tulua nvita tutshimuna misoko ei.
Bena Hiwi Amola, Yebuse Amona, Pelesheta ne Hu ne bena Pelese, Jikashi ne Hiti nanku ne tubuele.
«yesu udi muimane ku tshibi ukokola», «bua akusungile wewe udi mujimina» «a aleluya aleluya amena»

lines: (Compositeur: Papa Londa Yesu G2)

hymns.title: INDI JINGULULA KANANA SI MUSOKO

versions.title: INDI JINGULULA KANANA SI MUSOKO

lines: Indi jingulula kanana si musoko,”musoko wakalaya NZ mulya bana ba isalela”,

“Yakoba mene etshi tshidi disua dia NZ”
Lelu eu yeleko washimbuki,”budishikaminyi bua mueneki mu mutshima wa muntu yonso”,
“tshinyi tshiwamba tshivua munvua bimpe, tshivua mumanya bionso kanana musoko wa tshijila”
Muadi ne madilu bikole bidi pa buloba bujima, budi kabuyi ne budishikaminyi ku Di dia NZ.

hymns.title: ANU MUNKATSHI MUA BANTU

versions.title: ANU MUNKATSHI MUA BANTU

lines: Anu munkatshi mua bantu kemudi bukalenga bua NZ ke mudi makalenga a bantu nvita minene kuenzeka mu bantu,”ke mudi Goliata ne Davidi”
Goliata kujuka wamba bua bukole wakadi umuluisha anu bua bukalenga, “Davidi wamuashi lusoka wakumi mpala panshi”

hymns.title: WEWE GOLIATA DAVIDI NE AKUSHEBEYA

versions.title: WEWE GOLIATA DAVIDI NE AKUSHEBEYA

lines: Wewe Goliata Davidi neakushebeya, uluisha buakana, bule buebe budi coude isambombo ne ntata wa tshianza:" mvita ya Davidi ne Goliata"(bis)
Wela Davidi mulau mu mena a Nzambi webe, umulengulule difuma mu tshianza, bua kushipa Davidi nyama nyunyi bimudie: "mvita ya Davidi ne Goliata"(bis)
Mulami wa mikoko washipi Goliata ne lusoka lumue lumuasa mu mpala, tshilobo wa dishindi akumi mpala panshi:" mvita ya Davidi ne Goliata"(bis)

hymns.title: MUKALENGA WANYI BUALU EBU BUNENE

versions.title: MUKALENGA WANYI BUALU EBU BUNENE

lines: Mukalenga wanyi bualu ebu bunene meme tshiena bua kubukokesha.bualu bulelela bua kupa bena meji wakabupesha bana bakese.
Tshikondo tshia Noa, Bantu bakadi basanka kabayi batendelela NZ, nvula yakaloka bantu bakajinga NZ yeye pende kakabateleja.
Tshikondo tshia Lota, bantu bakadi basanka anu bu mudibu benza lelu, bantu bakabenga kunvua Dî dia yehowa yeye kubabutula ne kapia.
Dî dieba dia lupandu bananga didi koku lelu kumpala kua muntu yonso wa muoyo wa kakuitabuja,”nganyi muntu wakuambila ne meme tshiena munvua Dî, Dî dia lupandu”

hymns.title: BULELELA KAYI MPINDIEU (BULELELA BUA NZAMBI)

versions.title: BULELELA KAYI MPINDIEU (BULELELA BUA NZAMBI)

lines: Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi nabu pa buloba, butudi tuyisha bantu ba NZ«bulelela bua NZ anyi bua satana».
NZ kuambilaye muntu wakatekaye mu budimi biwadia mutshi eu ufuafua bulelela, satana pende ku muambila biwadia mutshi eu kuena ufua bulelela.
Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi tuyisha bantu ba NZ «Bulelela bua NZ anyi bua satana».
Pakafuka NZ bintu bitudi nabi pa buloba wakabifukila muntu bua asanke, «ne muntu wa NZ atumbe»
kadi lelu pa buloba kabatshiena bayisha bantu Dî dia NZ wa muoyo bamanya bulelela, bakadi anu babayisha bua bintu bia mubidi kamutshiyi bulelela.
Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi tuyisha bantu ba NZ «bulelela bua NZ anyi bua satana».
Bana betu bonso bananga badi basue kupeta muoyo, angatayi bonso mukanda nubale «ebelu chapita dikumi».
kanuena mua kulengela bua bintu binudi nufila bikala mindidimbi ya bintu bia mu diulu,
bua nyuma muimpe mumanyishi wa bualu bulelela,nyuma muimpe mbulelela.
Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi tuyisha bantu ba NZ. «bulelela bua NZ anyi bua satana».
bulelela, bulelela, bulelela, bulelela, bulelela o, bulelela ooo bulelela bua NZ,
«NZ mbulelela, yesu mbulelela, nyuma muimpe mbulelela»

hymns.title: NDI DILA MUADI BUA BISAMBA BIA BANTU

versions.title: NDI DILA MUADI BUA BISAMBA BIA BANTU

lines: Ndi dila muadi bua bisamba bia bantu «bidi bikuatshibua lelu kudi palo mu ejipitu»

«tuakupatuka mu bupika bua palo»

hymns.title: NZAMBI WAKAMBILA DAVIDI

versions.title: NZAMBI WAKAMBILA DAVIDI

lines: Nzambi wakambila Davidi wewe kuena ungibakila nzubu anu muan’ebe uwalela yeye neangezea mudimu anu muanebe Solomo yeye neamgibakila nzubu(bis)

hymns.title: NAKADI MULUNDA WA MALU APA BULOBA

versions.title: NAKADI MULUNDA WA MALU APA BULOBA

lines: Nakadi mulunda wa malu apa buloba,bu kamanya kua bulelela nakulua muluishi.”bakadi benda bangamba bua dina diebe”

hymns.title: MU NJILA YONSO INDI NGENDA

versions.title: MU NJILA YONSO INDI NGENDA

hymns.title: MU LUENDU LUANYI

versions.title: MU LUENDU LUANYI

hymns.title: MUNTU WAKADIKU YONE MUTUMA KUDI MUKALENGA

versions.title: MUNTU WAKADIKU YONE MUTUMA KUDI MUKALENGA

lines: Muntu wakadiku Yone mutuma kudi mukalenga uvua mudimu anu wa lumu luimpe wa kulongolola njila wa yesu muana wa NZ,
Heloda kukuata Yone bua Yone wakamuambila ki bimpa bua kuikala ne mukaji wa muan’enu; meji apa buloba udi nau bulunda wowo adi lufu.
Yone muela mu lukanu kunvua lumu lua Yesu, kutumayi bayidi bua bobo kumukonka, yesu pende kuandamuna ndayi nuambile Yone:
bafofo batabale,balema badi benda,bena nsudi balengele, bena mahaha bunvua, bafua badi babishibue, nuambila bantu kabuabo lumu lua NZ.
Kutangidi ku luseka badi bakuyisha wewe, kuikadi biebe Heloda mumana kukuata Yone mutumibue kudi NZ wa muoyo bua kumuenzela mudimu,
ntangila bueba bulunda udi anu ne Bulasto, kuikadi biebe ne muoyo anu bua bidia nkayabi,muanjelo wa mukalenga ne akututa lukasa tuishi ne tukudia.
“anu bua mukaji au: Yone yoyo Yone wakafua”

hymns.title: MUTSHI WA NFIGI NE UME

versions.title: MUTSHI WA NFIGI NE UME

lines: Mutshi wa nfigi ne ume bantu ne badile, nfigi lelu umi mutshi muela mulau, yesu monji munene wakasungula matamba, matamba bayidi bavua bakuama mamuma ngondo dikumi ne ibidi ku mutshi wa olege.
Tshisuyi tshiitapi mutshi, baluishi ba Dî bapatukidi patoka bonso aba bena yeleko, ntatu, nvita, bilumbu bivua bifumina kudibu,
bua tshipungu tshikuabo tshiotshi katshimueneki nansha, bua bobo kuditumbisha NZ wabedi tshijengu.

Muntu muindile mulayi muikala dinfuenkonya, buloba bua kuminyi muan’etu lelu washadi bualu uvua buloba wapinganyi ku buloba, wapangi kubuela ne kulua muna kilisto, mutshi bakaushimbula, kuujula ne miji yau.
Tuvua baya ku mukuna wa siona, malu makole akenzeka mu tshikondo tshietu, tshivua mumanya lelu eu meme ne buela mu diulu tuayi tshanga mu siona tudi mu diulu.

hymns.title: PAKABANGA BANTU KUVULANGANA

versions.title: PAKABANGA BANTU KUVULANGANA

hymns.title: KUVUA MUNTU UMBUKA MU YELUSHALEMA

versions.title: KUVUA MUNTU UMBUKA MU YELUSHALEMA

hymns.title: NZAMBI KUFUKA MUNTU, KU MUNANGA BIKOLE

versions.title: NZAMBI KUFUKA MUNTU, KU MUNANGA BIKOLE

lines: NZ kufuka muntu, ku munanga bikole, ku mulautshisha mabua a mushinga mukole,
bua kutumbisha nau NZ mufuki wetu muntu umona mabua ekubengaye NZ,
bua kutumbisha nau NZ mufuki wetu muntu umona mabwa ekukunzaye mesu.

«katuditumbishi, tutumbisha NZ, bua bintu bionso bitudi nabi bia NZ»

hymns.title: BUA KULAMBULA BALA MILAMBU

hymns.title: BENA KILISTO BAKENGA

versions.title: BENA KILISTO BAKENGA

lines: Bena kilisto bakenga bu muakakenga yesu muana .kanukemi bualu bua dikenga didi bu kapia munkantshi muenu, dia kulua kunudi bu diteta,dia kulua bu bualu bupiabupia,nuabanyangana bonso makenga nutendelela NZ wenu.

umua wenu kakengeshibue bu mushipianganyi bu muivi anyi bu muenji wa bubi bonso mudibueja mu malu a bantu.
Binualua bena lukunukunu lua kuenza kua malu mimpe kanulondi diyisha dikuabu anu dia kanushila kilisto,
ne nuasa tshifulu tshimpe ne nuluata tshilamba tshipia tshipia,ne nusombela bonso ku mesa a mukalenga yesu kilisto.
Muena lukuna wetu satana udi wendakana bu ntambua ukungula ukeba bia kudia tumutantamena bonso bikole.

hymns.title: BUA KULUA MUYIDI WENDE

versions.title: BUA KULUA MUYIDI WENDE

buloba : " buloba wewe mutumone kuambi ne tudi ba pa buloba", tuetu aba : "tudi ne mena mafunda ku mukanda wa Nzambi wa moyo,

hymns.title: MALU A KENZA YESU

versions.title: MALU A KENZA YESU

hymns.title: PAKABANGA YESU MUDIMU

versions.title: PAKABANGA YESU MUDIMU

lines: Pakabanga yesu mudimu wakaluilaye pa buloba wakakeba anu makunji a ekelezia: Andele, Petelo ni Yone ni Yakobo.

Makunji aa adi bilembi bia minyinyi ya mu mai, aba bakuata mishipa, aba baluka tupamba,

Pakapita matuku asatu yesu wakenza bualu bua dikema, mu dibanji dia dibaka mu kana wa galela,
bantu kabatshivua ne nvinyo nansha mukese, milondo misonga ya mabue ivua mitupu, bantu kûjabo mai, yesu kuandamuna nvinyo.
Yesu udi wambila bantu lekelayi tupamba, yesu udi wambila bantu patukayi mu buatu,
ndayi nunkebela bantu, bantu bajimina nulua nabo kudi NZ wa muoyo.
Yesu udi wambila bantu lekelayi tupamba, yesu udi wambila bantu patukayi mu buatu,
ndayi nunkebela bantu, nubaselesha bakaji, nubabanjija kabidi.

hymns.title: PAKABANDA YESU KU MUKUNA

Bu mudi yesu monji munene wa mamuma bayidi bandi matamba, ditamba kadiyi ku monji nansha kadiena mua kukuama mamuma nansha, ne bua kulua mupostolo bidi nunku.

hymns.title: DIA KUNSHIKIDILU NE UYE PENYI ?

«Dia lufu we yoyoyo ne wikale muaba kayi?

hymns.title: NYUMA MUIMPE KULOMBOLA YESU

lines: Nyuma muimpe kulombola yesu mu tshipela bua satana amuteya matuku makumi anai yesu wakadi ne nzala.

Elisha wakamuambila bumudi yehowa ne muoyo mutshima webe ne muoyo Eliya tuyaya nebe «bakaya ne Elisha ku Betele»
Bua ditabuja Eliya, Elisha kakapanga to bua kumulonda. Eliya kuambila Elisha wewe ushala kunoku «yehowa wakuntuma ku Yeleko»
Elisha wakamuambila bumudi yehowa ne muoyo mutshima webe ne muoyo Eliya tuyaya nebe «bakaya ne Elisha ku Yeleko»
Bana betu luayi tulondayi Dî dia nyuma tupeta muoyo, bumuakenza Elisha yeye kulonda Eliya «bakasabuka nende yadena»
Eliya Dî dia nyuma divua Elisha mulonda, Elisha wakangata tshikowelu, «bukole bua nyuma wa Eliya»
Eliya wakamuambila undombe tshiudi musue, Elisha wakalomba bitupa bibidi bia nyuma, wakalomba baulu bukole, bukole bua nyuma wa Eliya.
Hakamonaye Eliya uya mulu mu nvunda, Elisha wakadila: eyi tatu wanyi, eyi tatu wanyi, eyi tatu wanyi, dikalu dia isalela ne badi benda pa tubalu tuadi
«Eliya wakabanda tshikowelu kushala, elayi meji bimpe bua tuetu kuhiana»

hymns.title: NZAMBI TELEJA MUADI

versions.title: NZAMBI TELEJA MUADI

lines: NZ teleja muadi unvua kulomba kuetu, NZ ulue pa buipi ulue kutusamba.

Yehowa udi wamba diulu nkuasa wanyi, buloba tshitekelu tshia makasa anyi.
Utshidi unua mala wenda ukuna nkambua, kuena mumanya budi bukufukila wewe.

hymns.title: DÎ KE DIDI DILAMA NYUMA WA NZ

versions.title: DÎ KE DIDI DILAMA NYUMA WA NZ

lines: Dî ke didi dilama nyuma wa NZ bua kutamba malu onso apa buloba.
Biwikala wewe kuyi wenda ne Dî ne umbushibue munkatshi mua bana ba NZ,
«ne wikale ne muaba webe mu muaba wa bafue, ne ushale mu bintu biebe biuvua nabi”
Bua kupeta muoyo anu paunvua Dî ne wikale ne butumbi mu baulu bua NZ, ba pa buloba kabena bakuenzela bibi bua kuena nabu mu bobumue bua malu nansha
«nganyi wanyenga tshidi mu tshianza tshia yehowa NZ, tshinyi tshia pandulula ne dinanga dia NZ »
Ba pa buloba bonso bakushala mu mîdima bua munya mulelela ukadi kutudi «munya mulelela munya wa kudi NZ se dinanga dia NZ munkatshi mua bantu»
yoyoyo balunde: nyuma wa kilisto ke nsapi ya diulu, ne tusomba ne yesu mu bukalenga bua diulu, ne tusomba ne masiya mu bukalenga bua diulu.

hymns.title: YUDASA ISAKALIOTA

versions.title: YUDASA ISAKALIOTA

lines: Yudasa isakaliota wa mu dikumi ne babidi, mulunda wanyi wewe mutuma kudi bakuidi ne bafundi bua kutua yesu mishiku, tshimanyinu tshia tshitungu.
Wewe udi Kayafa muakuidi munene wa NZ, mukulu ne mufundi ushiminyina yesu malu, wamonu ne wakutuishi wamufidi kua Pilato.
Yesu anyi Balaba? Bakasungula Balaba, balaba ikala ne muoyo, bakambila Pilato mashi a muntu eu yesu ikala pambidi petu ne pa bana betu yesu afue watutondu.
«Labi muoyo, labi muoyo, labi muoyo» yesu kuamba yudasa enza lukasa, bualu buebe, lekela kuntua mishiku yebe ya tshitungu mulunda wanyi.

hymns.title: WEWE MUAN’ETU WANYI MU YESU

versions.title: WEWE MUAN’ETU WANYI MU YESU

Biwakala bualu ne muan’enu umubikile nusomba pamue, umuambila ne muan’etu wanyi suaku umbuikidila mibi yanyi, ne nutondelangana mapanga ne nulombelanga NZ

Bualu bua nfumu yesu kilisto yeye wakafua ku gologota, mashi ne mai bia kapueka bimatshila mu ngenyi yetu, biwakla wewe mujimina upingana lelu kudi yesu

hymns.title: TSHIANGA NE BUTUMBI LELU KUDI NZAMBI

versions.title: TSHIANGA NE BUTUMBI LELU KUDI NZAMBI

lines: Tshianga ne butumbi lelu kudi Nzambi, ditalala ne disanka kudi bantu" bakalonda Di, bakalonda Nzambi wa muoyo"(bis)
(Nzambi wanyi): " bukalenga budi buebe mu diulu ne pa buloba"" kakuena wa kutamba wewe mu diulu ne pa buloba"(bis)
Nunku lelu vuluka tshipungidi " tshi tuakapunga nebe kumpala kua mukalenga"
Nzambi sungula kuenzela mudimu wa kuyisha kua bantu, Nzambi sungula kuenzela mudimu wa kondopa kua bantu,
Nzambi sungula kuenzela mudimu wakusungila bantu, Nzambi sungula kuenzela mudimu wakubela kua bantu.(bis)
Nunku lelu jadika tshipungidi" tshituakapunga nebe mu nzubu wa masungula"
tshia kumbanyi lelu tshia kuyisha kua bantu, tshiakumbanyi lelu tshia kondopa kua bantu, tshia kumbanyi lelu tshia kusungila bantu, tshia kumbanyi lelu tshia kubela kua bantu.(bis)

hymns.title: TSHIENA NE KUA KUNYEMENA TO

versions.title: TSHIENA NE KUA KUNYEMENA TO

lines: Tshiena ne kua kukenyema too panakupidia wewe Yepowa dibue dianyi Yepowa ngambu wanyi (bis)
Nzambi kuyi kule to wa luse kudenkedi to dibue dianyi undame meme usonkoka ne luse dibue dia tshieyemenu Nzambi umbuikidila mibi (bis)
Mushima kukanki to udi mukusambi ne mukulami muimpe Nzambi palua makenga onso (bis)
Ne nteke moyo wanyi meme mu bianza bia Yepowa nensanka bua Yepowa Nzambi utshidi ukolesha (bis)
Nzambi wa Abalahama Nzambi wa Izaka ne Yakobo dibue dia mu Siyona Nzambi usokoka ne luse (bis)

hymns.title: KU LUSE LUEBA YEHOWA

versions.title: KU LUSE LUEBA YEHOWA

lines: " Ku luse luebe Yehowa wa nsungulu mu ba pa buloba" " ke bua muoyo wanyi muimpe anyi bua bienzedi bianyi"" kadi utuwasungula bantu anu bua ngasa webe"(bis)
" Nakalomba meme kudila muadi mukulomba kuanyi we yoyoyo mutshikondo tshia masungula eba"
" nakadila meme kudila muadi bua ufunda panyi weyoyoyo dina dianyi kumukanda wa muoyo""mukulomba kuanyi we yoyoyo wakantumina nimero yanyi"(bis)
" Mema kuya ku mukuna webe mutshijila mu matuku tshitema" " anu bua ku ujibua nteta ne bukola bua kudi nyuma muimpe"
" meme kuedibua manyi atshijila, manyi mimpa a bukalenga bueba" (bis)
" Bua kujadika bukola buebe na kalenga bimaryinu bitanu" " kapia kuntemena pa lubombo, meme kulota ekumona malu,
meme ekuujibua ntenta, pashishe kubanga kuenezjibua"(bis)

hymns.title: WEWA NZAMBI WAKANGELA MANYI

versions.title: WEWA NZAMBI WAKANGELA MANYI

lines: Wewa NZ wakangela manyi kunjadika mu mudimu webe, kuimanyika maboko anyi mulu "NZ wanyi diba kadibuedi meme kuenzela mudimu"
Mudimu weba uwakumpa mudi nvita mitamba bukole, ifuilakana ne dina diebe "NZ wanyi mpesha dikima ne bukole mu mudimu"
Tshiena nya ku tshianza tshia balume, tshiena nya ku tshianza tshia bakaji, bua tshipendesheshi dina diebe "ngamba lumu lua kilisto bu muakadilu ku kale"
Yoshua wakamanyika diba kushipayi bena pelesheta, bonso kufua ku muela wa nvita "NZ wanyi diba kadibuedi mema ntamba bena lukuna"

hymns.title: EYI BANA BETU TSHIKONDO TSHIAKUKUMBANA WE

versions.title: EYI BANA BETU TSHIKONDO TSHIAKUKUMBANA WE

lines: "Eyi bana betu tshikondo tshiakukumbana we tshia kuangata mulayi wa NZ, mulayi wa nyuma muimpe" "tuimbayi tutua tshianga we tutumbisha mukalenga"
"Yesu wa NZ wakambila bayidi ne kanumbuki mu yelushalema, yelushalema nuindile mulayi" "tuimbayi tutua tshianga we tutumbisha mukalenga"
"Malu onso a pa buloba ebu kaena ne muoyo munda muawu, nakaenza ekuenzulula, ekuenzulula muakadi anu lufu" "lekelayi difilayi we kudi yehowa mukalenga"
"Tshiena nshala we: nyaya mu masanka a mu diulu"

hymns.title: MU MATUKU A KUNSHIKIDILU

versions.title: MU MATUKU A KUNSHIKIDILU

lines: Mu matuku a kunshikidilu a tshipungu tshinayi Di kulua ku mukuna e kungambila tangila mifuba mu tshibanda "udilengeja ne bantu bebe buloba bonso busanke"
"Lubena, Simeone, Lewi ne bana bonso" ba Yakoba "kukuilayi Yuda ke mukalenga wakapiana nsapi ne dikombo"
"Muana buta wa Yuda dina diandi Palese" "wakamueneka ku tshianza tshikole bua butumbi bua mukalenga"
"Muadi yoyoyo an yovoyo" "tuapetshi nyuma mukokeshi bualu bua kukema kudibu" "diulu dionso dizakajibua buloba bonso bukokeshiba"

hymns.title: TSHIKONDO ETSHI TSHIA KUSUNGULULA

versions.title: TSHIKONDO ETSHI TSHIA KUSUNGULULA

lines: Tshikondo etshi tshia kusungulula lupela ne mponda tshikondo tshia kutapulula mbuji ne mikoko "nakatangila Nzambi mubulula mukanda wa moyo"(bis)
 Nzambi kutela; numero yanyi
 Nzambi kufunda ne dina dianyi"
 Alleluia disanka; "meme kusanka kutumbisha Yepowa wanyi" (bis)
Patuakadi bonso basangile mu nzubu wa mulu "tshipepela kufuma mu diulu kuuja nzubu yonso nteta"
"basungula ndimi ya kapia kumueneka pa mutu pa muntu yonso" (bis)
tuetu nenu bananga; "tudibakuatshike"(bis) nyuma wa butumbi
Commentaires
 Misambu itudi tuimbe
 Maaja atudi tuja
 Bile itudi tuela etc…
"Ebu bualu buakamba Profete Yoela" diyi diakamba Nzambi "mema ne ngitshikija nyuma wanyi pa mbidi penu" mu matuku akutshikidilu (bis)
 "lelu mulayi wa tatu; wakumkubana nyuma muimpe wapueke mu bantu"
 "tuetu nebe tukadi ba mu diulu katuena pa buloba"
 "tuepueke mu bantu emu bua kuenza mudimu ne kusungila batshidi ne malu "

hymns.title: PELABU MPUNGI WA NZAMBI

versions.title: PELABU MPUNGI WA NZAMBI

lines: Pelabu mpungi wa Nzambi bafua ne babikemu ngasa wa munya bindila wa misumba "nyaya ka muakidila mu njila wa lupandu"bis
Buelayi, buelayi, buelayi nungata muoyo"uvuaku ditatu udiku dimuana"(bis)
Tatu wanyi udi dituku meme ne mufuane, bia mbikilaye dilolo ne ngitaba ne dinda,"nyaya mutual mutshi wanyi mutshiamakane"(bis)
Luayi numone dibatija didi dingindile dia kunua lupanza bua bualu bua bafue "nyaya kateka muoyo wanyi mu bianza bia babi"(bis)

hymns.title: UNVUA KULOMBA KUANYI

versions.title: UNVUA KULOMBA KUANYI

lines: Unvua kulomba kuanyi muadi wanyi ufike kudi “uteleja matshi eba kundi mu dituku dia dikenga diany”
Ndi mupungila bualu bua kudila kuanyi “muminu wanyi wa kunguma bikole ne muadi yo wewe NZ wanyi”
Nakulua nakulua bu muana wa nshiya, nfikeku batuta bapenda, nfikeku bipata “ne nyemena kudi tatu wewe NZ wanyi”
Yehowa wanyi: unzulula matshi eba wangata milombo yanyi eyi, butumbi bueba ne bumueke mu diulu ne pa buloba.
(yesu muana, nyuma muimpe)

hymns.title: MUPROFETA KATU NE BUTUMBI

versions.title: MUPROFETA KATU NE BUTUMBI

lines: Muprofeta katu ne butumbi “mu tshisamba tshiabo kadi anu mu tshia benda” “nudimuka balunda nulonda anu mutoto” “nufika padi muana bua nuenu kusawila”
Bua tshipimi tshia NZ tshidi bua muntu yonso “avuijibua muakana ku lumuenu lua NZ” “kakuena ni mukesa, kakuena ni munene” “kumpala kua NZ tudi anu momumue”
Nudimuke balunda bua yesu wa NZ “biasombaye mu nkuasa bua kulumbuluisha” “ne atapulula mbuji ne mikoko kabidi”
Nudimuke dialua muana wa NZ didi bualu busokoka balunda kudi ba pa buloba.

hymns.title: NJILA WA MUOYO

versions.title: NJILA WA MUOYO

lines: “Njila wa muoyo, njila wa muoyo wa NZ” “wakajimija Adama ne Eva pakadibo mu budimi”
“NZ kuteka bakeluba ne muela” “bua kulamabo njila wa ku mutshi wa muoyo”
“Dilua dia yesu se dimueneka dia njila” “wewe uyila Dî ne upeta muoyo”
“Tudi ne disanka dia kudi NZ” “bualu tuakendela tuetu mu njila wa muoyo” “tuakayila Dî lelu tuapatshi muoyo”

hymns.title: TSHIBANGIDILU TSHIA LUMU LUIMPE LUA YESU

versions.title: TSHIBANGIDILU TSHIA LUMU LUIMPE LUA YESU

lines: Tshibangidilu tshia lumu luimpe “lua yesu kilisto muana wa NZ” “wakasungula bayidi bandi dikumi ne babidi” “(muana wa NZ) wakenza mudimu mukole bua mioyo ya bantu”

“Yudasa kutungila yesu kilisto muana NZ” bakamupopela yoyoyo milonda mu bianza ne minga mu makasa yesu kayi ne bualu, bakamutua difuma mai ne mashi bia patuka “bua kusungila bantu bonso ba panshi pa buloba”

“Pilato kubatekelaye yesu ne balaba” bena yuda bonso bakasungula balaba, balaba ikala ne muoyo, bakasungula balaba, balaba mushipi wa bantu, bakambila Pilato yesu afue biandi “mashi a yesu ikala pambidi petu ne pa bana betu”

hymns.title: NYAYA MUTANGILE MU BISAMBA BIA BENDE

versions.title: NYAYA MUTANGILE MU BISAMBA BIA BENDE

lines: Nyaya mutangile mu bisamba bia bende “nyaya bua kuambila bukua bisamba lumu luimpe lua NZ” “NZ atuma muanjelo wende yeye ikala kumpala kuanyi”
Ndi muena mudimu wa kuamba kua lumu “ne ngamba mu miaba mimpe ne mu miaba idi kayiyi mimpe”
Ndi ndomba kudi wewe nyuma “ulua bua kumpa bukole bua kuakula mu miaku yonso” “ne kumuenesha butumbi buebe kudi ba bisamba bia bende”
Ndi ndomba NZ adianjila kumpala kuanyi, ndi ndomba yesu adianjila kumpala kuanyi, ndi ndomba nyuma adianjila kumpala kuanyi bua kenza mudimu.

hymns.title: NZAMBI WAKAMBA NOA ENZA BUATU

versions.title: NZAMBI WAKAMBA NOA ENZA BUATU

lines: “NZ wakamba Noa enza buatu” “gopher ikala, ikala mutshi wa buatu” “ubuenza ne nzubu munda mikesa isatu” mu buatu.

“Nzubu eyi isatu yakenza Noa mu buatu”, kuvua Nzubu wa nyama nyama anu ibidi ibidi, kuvua nzubu wa nyunyi nyunyi anu ibidi ibidi, kuvua nzubu wa bantu bantu muanda mukulu, banyabanya mu buatu bantu muanda mukulu mu buatu.
“Bua kubuela mu buatu bua Noa” fila quinze(15) weba udipuekesha ku Dî, uluata muanda mukulu uyila Dî dia NZ upeta muoyo.
Noa wetu saka buatu pa mai: enza mudimu wa NZ, enza mudimu ujikija.

hymns.title: KUJIKIJA KUA MUDIMU WA MUAMBI

versions.title: KUJIKIJA KUA MUDIMU WA MUAMBI

lines: Kujikija kua mudimu wa muambi wakalaya bantu wamba Di ne nyuma biobio ne bitayika" bantu ne balue bua kumona muana muina ngua tshipungu kayi? "(bis)
Bua bualu bua mulayi: mulayi ngua bisamba bionso, mulayi ngua bipungu bionso, mulayi ngua muntu yonso" tuayi tshiangawe yoyoyo Yehowa Nzambi wa bukole"(bis)
Mukaji muluatshisha ne diba ngondo muinshi mua makasa ne tshifulu tshia mitoto " yeye waledi muana mukokeshi wa bisamba bionso"" amba kukokesha bantu ne Di dia Nzambi"(bis)
Bua meji a mubidi ne kusua kua nkuasa" satana nyeu wapueki muikala ne tshiji tshikole"" bantu nuabengi nyuma nuanangi mubidi "(bis)

hymns.title: MUNTU WA MU TSHISAMBA TSHIA LEWI

versions.title: MUNTU WA MU TSHISAMBA TSHIA LEWI

lines: Muntu wa mu tshisamba tshia Lewi wakadi ne mukaji,“wakalela muana kumuladika mu kasaka” “kumuteka mu malenga a kumuelelu wa mai”
Muana wa bakaji wa palo wakamona muana “wakamupa dina ne Mose wa NZ” “nakamuangula ku muelelu wa mai”
Pakakola Mose “wakapidia bua kubikidibua bu muana wa palo” “wakakokesha banfumu ne nkama ya bantu”
“Mose mukenji:mukenji wa NZ wa muoyo wa kumueneka”,“neye nau mu bantu bua kubambila”

hymns.title: NUENU BENA ATHENA

versions.title: NUENU BENA ATHENA

lines: Nuenu bena Athena “ndi ntangila mu malu onso nudi nutshina NZ yenu” “panakadi mpita mu njila nakasangana tshioshelu ne dina difunda ne udi nzambi udi kayi mumaniyibua”
Nudi nutendelela tshinudi kanuyi bamanya ndi nuleja NZ mufuki wa bionso “katuwashikama mu nzubu miasa ku bianza bia bantu, diulu nkuasa wenda buloba tshitekelu tshia makasa”
Binuashibua bonso ku Dî dia nyuma nudi bu nzubu wa NZ udi kayi muasa ne bianza “bualu NZ wakamba tshianza tshia muntu katshiena tshimukuatshila mudimu bu padiye ne tshintu bualu”
“Bialua muntu kunudi nuenu ne lumu lupialupia “ludi kaluyi lua kilisto kanumuitabuji”
“nansha tuetu aba, nansha muanjelo wa mu diulu ikala biandi ne mulau”

hymns.title: LELU DITUKU DITUAKAPATUKA

versions.title: LELU DITUKU DITUAKAPATUKA

lines: Lelu dituku dituakapatuka munkatshi mua benji ba malu mabi " Yehowa Nzambi wakatusungila munkatshi mua bantu ba pa buloba"(bis)
" Tutuayi tshianglele"Yesu Kilisto muana wa Nzambo wakatusungila.(bis)
Yesu wakamba nakuteka muoyo, muoyo wanyi panshi bua bualu buenu" nuteka bienu mioyo yenu panshi bualu bua bakaubo batshidi mulufu"(bis)
Mu bantu mutu ayi bua kuteka mioyo, mioyo yetu panshi bua bualu buabo" tuateki lufu, masandi nenkinu, kushebeya bantu nekubela mungena"(bis)

hymns.title: BAMBI BA NZAMBI NUATULAMA BIMPE

versions.title: BAMBI BA NZAMBI NUATULAMA BIMPE

lines: Bambi ba NZ nuatulama bimpe, Mose wakapangila mulayi.
Diulu ne buloba ebi biakafuka NZ, tshinudi nukengela tshinganyi.
NZ ne atupa midimi itudi tukeba, kadi kuvenza kudi kukole.
NZ ne atupa difutu ditudi tukeba, tshilumbuluidi tshidi tshikole.
Tulonda yehowa, yehowa, yehowa; tulonda yesu ne tusungidibue.

hymns.title: DIA KUKUATA NVULA

versions.title: DIA KUKUATA NVULA

lines: Dia kukuata nvula ne ujinga munya, mona Yudasa kusanka bua kutungila yesu, kudilumbuluisha bua tshivuaye muenza bua kupanga ditalala mu mutshima wende “anu buena lomo ke budi bushipesha bantu”
Muntu wa mitshima ibidi udi anu bu satana, mu njila yenda yonso udi anu bu tshilongu, disua dia kulonda NZ udi nadi “disua dia kulonda bantu udi nadi, kadi wakufuta nganyi”
NZ wakateka muoyo ne lufu kumpala kua muntu, usungula njila wa NZ wikale ne muoyo, biwasungula njila wa bantu neufua mu bantu “tuendayi badimuke mu bantu ba pa buloba”
NZ katu wandamuka udi anu momumue, wewe mumubenga wenji bimpe, wewe mumuitaba wenji biakane, NZ wa ba muoyo ne bafue kabidi,
tuyayi mu munya ne tupeta muoyo “munya watemi lelu mu mitshima yetu”

hymns.title: NE NGANVI WALUMBULUSHA BASUNGULA BA NZAMBI

versions.title: NE NGANVI WALUMBULUSHA BASUNGULA BA NZAMBI

lines: Ne nganyi walumbuluisha basungula ba NZ “NZ yeye nkayende ke mulumbuluishi wabo”
“Bakafunda makenga a kilisto bua bualu buanyi” “wakengi lelu bua kusungila meme”
Ne nganyi:
• Ne nganyi wampandulula meme ne dinanga dia NZ, ne tatu wanyi ni mamu wanyi, ni bayanyi wanyi, ni mukaji wanyi “nansha bana banyi kabena mua kumpandulula”
• Tshinganyi tshiampandulula meme ne dinanga dia NZ yoyi, mestu andi muasa anyi makasa andi nawu “bianza ne diulu kabiena mua kumpandulula”
• Tshinganyi tshiampandulula ne dinanga dia NZ yoyi, ntatu yanyi yonso anyi

hymns.title: NAYAYA KU LUENDU LULE LULE

versions.title: NAYAYA KU LUENDU LULE LULE

lines: Nyaya ku luendu lule lule mutangila kua NZ “ndi mupungila ne bujitu ne mudimu mukole” “nganyi wanyi wangambuisha bua mpeta dikisha”
“Ngamba ne ngikishaku mbotshia mingimanyina” “ne ntambua ne nkashama bua meme ku bienzela mudimu”
“Yesu, yesu udi Dî dia NZ” bujitu se bijanu biebe, bujitu se kunua kua maluvu; fila kudi yesu bua umona mua kufika, fila kudi yesu bua umona mua kuikisha.
“Anu yesu” muana wa NZ nyeu molola bianza ubikila badi ne majitu, badi ne mudimu mukole bobo bua bapeta dikisha.

hymns.title: BAWAKUPESHA BUKOKESHI

versions.title: BAWAKUPESHA BUKOKESHI

lines: Bawakupesha bukokeshi luvungulu lua diulu bua kukanga ne bua kunzulula ne ku muaba wa bafue; tshiasuikabu panshi tshiasuikabu mu diulu kudi yehowa; tshiasululabu panshi tshiasululabu mu diulu kudi yehowa.
Nfumu’etu yesu musungidi wakamupa bukola bua kutamba nyuma ya bukoya kuyumusha mu bantu, kujikija masama ne mateketa bia mishindu ya bungi.
Betuabu mu dina dia tatu tunaudi betuabu, betuabu mu dina dia muana tunaudi betuabu, betuabu mu dina dia nyuma tunaudi betuabu “betuabu betuabu mu dina dia mukalenga”
Nkudimba yeba yabuki mulu ne nkutshi yeba yabuki mulu, yatangalaki mu lupepela yenda ipepela “yenda ikila badi neba mu bobumue bua bapeta muoyo”
betuabu betuabu bana balume ba mukalenga, betuabu betuabu nuenu bilobo bia mukalenga, betuabu betuabu minyampala ya mukalenga.

hymns.title: NDI NSANKA BUA DÎ DIA MUOYO

versions.title: NDI NSANKA BUA DÎ DIA MUOYO

lines: “Ndi nsanka bua Dî dia muoyo” “Dî dia kalua kundi meme bua kunsungila” “panakadi mu tshiota Dî dia kansungila” “ne mu malu a bantu Dî dia kansungila”
Dî edi didi ne mudimu muimpe wa kuyisha muntu, ne kubela muntu, ne kudimuija muntu, ne kulongolola muntu “muntu akumbajibue mu buakana bua NZ”
Malu makane ne malelela “malu mimpe onso adi munda mua Dî “ “wewe muyidi wa Dî ulama Dî bimpe”
Yoyoiwine: endayi mu Dî, shalayi mu Dî “numanya bulelela nudishikamine” “nusungidibue, nupandishibue”

hymns.title: YAKOBA WAKALUANGANA NE NZAMBI

versions.title: YAKOBA WAKALUANGANA NE NZAMBI

lines: “Yakoba wakaluangana ne NZ mu njila wa Peniele“ mu buloba bua Edoma wakamutamba bukola wakamuambila “yehowa wewe munsankisha meme nenkulekele“
NZ wakasankisha Yakoba wakamuambila ne “wewe kuena Yakoba lelu udi Isalela“ “watshimunyi bantu, watshimunyi NZ“
Kuikala muena isalela “nkuenda ne mukolo umue se lumu luimpe“
Kutshimuna NZ wa muoyo:“kubenga kuenza bubi mu mutshima webe“, kutshimuna ba pa buloba:“itabuja bubi bukuenzela wewe ne usungila muoyo“

hymns.title: NAKAKUATA MUDIMU UWAKAMBIKIDILA

versions.title: NAKAKUATA MUDIMU UWAKAMBIKIDILA

lines: Nakakua ta mudimu uwakambikidila tshiakatanda ne muntu tshiakakengesha muntu, nakaleja dinanga kudi bayidi banyi, yehowa NZ udi difutu dianyi.
Bena lukuna banyi bavua banyunguluka babisha bianza mulu bua kunduangisha nvita, tshiakaleja makanda avua mu mubidi wanyi yehowa wakantshimuina baluishi.
Nuenu tshipungu tshinayi nudi babikidibue bua kulongolola njila idi mikonyangale, nuenu nudi mukanda mufunda munda ne pambelu badi banubala kuonso kunuyaya.
Udi NZ wa luse ba pa buloba bawakumpa ngabaleji dina dieba kabena kabidi pa buloba, NZ wanyi ndi kulomba ubasungila kudi bubi.

hymns.title: NYAYA MU LIUNDU LELU

versions.title: NYAYA MU LIUNDU LELU

lines: Nyaya mu luendu lelu, nyaya mu luendu lelu bua kumonangana ne mufuki muena kulu muena bantu; nushala bandamina muaba wanyi ndi ndua.
Nyaya mu diulu lelu, nyaya mu diulu lelu bua kumonangana ne mufuki muena kulu muena bantu, nushala bandamina muaba wanyi ndi ndua.
Tuenzayi malu mimpe, tuenzayi malu mimpe bua kumonangana ne mufuki muena kulu muena bantu; nushala bandamina muaba wanyi ndi ndua.
lufu bu mema mumanya diba diwalua eyi nakadi kuela meji bimpe, nakadi kulaya balunda banyi bonso,”meme ngayi we ngayi we yoyoyo nushala bilenga”

hymns.title: SHAULA UVUA NE DIKIMA

versions.title: NGAMBILA NGANYI DÎ

lines: Ngambila nganyi Dî NZ wanyi? Mbikila ngayi tatu ne itaba kundi,bua lukuka luabiuma ne malu a panshi,
“lumu luimpe lua kunyanguka mu bantu ba panshi bua nfualanga ne nkuasa”
Ngamba Dî ndila kudikanda kudi kuntonda bakadi benda mu midima bakamona munya,
“munya munene kutemena mu mitshima ya bantu bua Dî dia muoyo”
Panutshidi ne munya nuitabuja munya, endakanayi mu munya patshidiu mu kantshi muenu,
“tumbishayi NZ wa muoyo: tuamutumbishi bua Dî dia muoyo”
disanka dianyi, butumbi buanyi NZ wanyi; dikenga dianyi, kulomba kuanyi mu bualu bua NZ,
“tshinayi mufuki ke muoyo wa tshiendelela bua tatu a tumbisha muana kashidi”
Bua Dî dia NZ:
• ne nye kudi bana betu bena NZ, bena NZ kutuyisha muoyo maria nkofesa ne malu
• ne nye kudi bana betu bena nyuma, bena nyuma kutuyisha mua kuela nfalanga bua mianzu ne nkuasa
• ne nye kudi tshiota tshianyi ne balunda, ne mbambila Dî dia muoyo.

Petelo wakaya kubuela mu kayisaliya wakenza mudimu wa kamushilabo mu tshilamba ushipa udia nyama nyoka ne nyunyi wakajikija mudimu wa nyuma mua konelio.

lelu ndituku dia pentecoste tshiona tshia mu diulu bavua popamue mu muaba umue bonso bavua ne dinanga; bavua bakula mu miaku mikuabu bimpa ne misa, bualu diba ditshivu anu pa tshitema kimbanua maluvu.
Konelio bonso bakunvua bakanganta nyuma kuatayi malala ku bianza elayi bianza mulu; nyuma muimpe mutupeukele, nyuma wabulelela tshiakalengeja mufuki kanuambi ne tsihatshianana.
Petelo musomba ulota kumonayi tshilamba tshikuata kunzemba inayi kuledibua kua butumbi kua bena konelio kanulumbuludi malu malu adi munda mua bakuabu.
Nzambi wetu udi momumue kayi ni kansungansunga nyuma udi anu momumue kanutangidi bantu; nyuma muimpe mutupeukele nyuma wa bulelela tshiakalengeja mufuki kanuambi ni tshia tshianana.

lines: Abalahama wakadi ne bana babidi: umue wa ku Sinai mulelela bu bana bonso, umue wa ku Siona mulelela kulela kua nyuma
"tshi nfuanyikijilu tshia Isaka ne Yishamaela"(bis)
nfuanyikijilu tshia Isaka ne Yishamaela"(bis)
wewe Abalahama ipataku Haga mupika ne muana wandi, bualu kena mua kupiana pamua ne muana wanyi,
Abalahama wakalomba kudi yehowa Nzambi "Yishamaela ikala ne muoyo kafu biandi" (bis)
Bakaji babidi, bipungu bibidi bia kapunga yehowa Nzambi ni nkambua Abalahama:
Haga yelushalema mupika ne muana wandi, Sala yelushalema muledi wa bakalenga " tshinfuanyikijilu tshia Isaka ne Yishamaela" (bis)
Yehowa Nzambi wakasanka bua kusungila bantu kumashi amusungidi a yesu muanandi;
lelu tudi ne disanka bualu tuapetshi mulayi, tudi bana ba bupianyi bu muakadi Isaka"
tshinfuanyikijilu tshia Isaka ne Yishamaela " (bis)

hymns.title: ABALAHAMAEEE ABALAMAAA, TANGILA MUANA WEBA ISHAMELA NYA USEKA MUANA WANYI MUNANGE.

versions.title: ABALAHAMAEEE ABALAMAAA, TANGILA MUANA WEBA ISHAMELA NYA USEKA MUANA WANYI MUNANGE.

lines: " Abalahamaeee Abalamaaa"bis, tangila muan’eba Ishamela nya useka muan’anyi munanga:
Izaka wanyi, "muana mupe ta mu diyi, Izaka wanyi muana mupe te mu diunvua ne dimanya ne dijadika dia maalu a nyuma, Izaka wanyi"."
Yepowa wa misumba ndi kutendekena Nzambi wanyi bua wewa kundamina moyo mule upela oho ki bubanji buanyi bualu bua muana mukaji mupika,
Ishamela eu mulela bu bana bonso, nyeu ukengesha muananye mulela mu kulelea kua nyuma.
Meme panyi nya ntdekena Nzambi wanyi, bua yeye kukolesha mu ditabuja dinakangata bu dipa bualu;
" bua maalu adi aleduisha bantu, kahena apanga kulua lelu biambamba bibuela mu bantuee."
Aga penda udi mukuna wa Sinai mu Alaba, mu mulongu umue ne Yelushalema
" muena bana benda bapikaaaa, Yeshalema wa mu diulu mudishikamine udi baba wetu " ;
" ipataku muana mupika ne mamu’ende, ipataku muana mupika ne mamu’ende "

hymns.title: ADAMA NÉ EVA, BAKAPIDIA TATU NZAMBI, MAKENGA AKABAKUATA

versions.title: ADAMA NÉ EVA, BAKAPIDIA TATU NZAMBI, MAKENGA AKABAKUATA

lines: Adama ne Eva bakapidia Nzambi wabo makenga akabakuata.(bis)
wewe mubengi wa Nzambi udikonke ku luseka luudi wewa.(bis)
Nfumu Yesu muana Nzambi wakalua pa buloba bua kupikulaye bantu.(bis)
Udionka wewa lelu ku luseka ludi wewa lua bunji anyi lua mikoko.(bis)

hymns.title: ADAMA WAKADI NÉ BANA BABIDI, MUKULUMPE KANA WAKADI TSHIDIMA.

versions.title: ADAMA WAKADI NÉ BANA BABIDI, MUKULUMPE KANA WAKADI TSHIDIMA.

lines: Adama wakadi ne bana babidi, mukulumpa Kana wakadi tshidima," muakunyi Ebelo mulami wa mikoko" (bis)
Banana tulama Diyi tulekela lukinu" katulu kukengeshibua bua kumona kua malu a bantu,"
Kana muna tshiendenda: wa katambakana bua kumona kua malu a bantu"(bis)
Commentaires:
Dinga dituku Kana ne Ebelo bakaya ne milambu yabo kudi Nzambi," mulambu wa Ebelo wa kitabujibua" (bis)
"Telejayi tshiakuidi tshia mufuki nuenu bananga" bikala Kana musombuedi bua misangu muanda mutekete," ikala kundi makumi muanda muteketa ne muanda muteketa" (bis)

hymns.title: ADAMA WA KAMANYANGANA NÉ EVA MUKAJI WANDI YEYE WAKALELA KANA NE EBELU

versions.title: ADAMA WA KAMANYANGANA NÉ EVA MUKAJI WANDI YEYE WAKALELA KANA NE EBELU

lines: Adama waka manyangana ni Eva mukaji wandi " yeye wakalela Kana ne Ebelo",
„Kana tshidima yoyoiwe Ebelo mulami wa mikoko"(bis)
wewe muanetu mu Kilisto udi Kana bubi bua bantu anyi " peshi udi Ebelo buakana bua Nzambi"
ne ulambula mikoko anyi bimenyi gia pa buloba" (bis)
Yehowa wakitabuja mulambu wa Ebelo yeye "wa kapidia mulambu wa Kana" "Kana wakabungama wa kunvua tshiji"(bis)
Tuetu bena Kilisto tupidiaji Kana," tushala ne Ebelo buakana bua Nzambi" " netupeta muoyo wa kashidi"(bis)

hymns.title: AHABA WAKADI MUKOKESHI MU BULOBA BUABUA

versions.title: AHABA WAKADI MUKOKESHI MU BULOBA BUABUA

lines: Ahaba wakadi mukokeshi mu buloba buabua" wakanjinga budimi bua Nabota mue na Izalele",
"wakamuambila ne meme nshala nabu nkuna matshitshi anyi" (bis)
Nabota wakadila tshiena mpana budimi,"" bua budimi buanyi "tshiena mpana budimi bumpianyi bua bankambua banyi." (bis)
Izabela ekumuambila kuena ukokeshi mu Isalela anyi? "juka udie usanke nenkupa budimi bua Nabota" (bis)
Izabela muimane ne miketa yende upesha Yehu budimi, utshina Ahaba. "usungila budimi buebe bua tumuma tukese"(bis)

hymns.title: ANA WENDA UDIDILA NZAMBI

versions.title: ANA WENDA UDIDILA NZAMBI

lines: "Ana wenda udidila Nzambi" "Nzambi uanyi, pesha bianyi muana meme ndi kusakidila" (bis)
"Ana kujila biankudia ekulombaye Nzambi" "Nzambi uanyi, pesha bianyi muana meme ndi kusakidila" (bis)
"Muakuidi wa Nzambi wakalua ekukonkaye Anna" wewe udi munua mala anyi?
meme ntshiena munua mala , "meme ndi ndomba bianyi, "Nzambi uanyi pesha bianyi muana meme ndi kusakidila" (bis)
