hymns.title: ANU MÛ TSHIPELA KE MUDI MOSA UDISHILA MIKOKO.

versions.title: ANU MÛ TSHIPELA KE MUDI MOSA UDISHILA MIKOKO.

lines: "Anu mu tshipela ke mudi Mosa udishila mikoko", muakamonaye kashi katema ne kadilu,
"Di dia kamubikila: Mose Mose ubusha bilatu bualu buloba budi muimana bua tshidila"(bis)
• "Udi mu tshipela kayi? Tshia Mosa anyi tshia Yona anyi tshia Yesu musungidi udi mu tshipela kayi?"
• Tshipela tshia Mosa bua kutapulula bubi ne buimpa udi mu tshipela kayi?
• Tshipela tshia Yona bua kutamba maalu adi pa buloba udi mu tshipela kayi?
• Tshipela tshia Yesu, bua kuleja moyo udi munda mueba tuenzayi bua bakuabo. (bis)
Anu mu tshipela kimu Yona wela lubila luandi wambila bantu bonso bakudimuna mioyo,
"bapatuka mu Mosa bitabuja musungidi bobo balulamija njila" (bis)
Anu mu tshipela Yesu kuteyibua kudi satana "Yeye waka mutamba", "Yeye mena kakateyibua wakatamba malu a buloba"(bis)

hymns.title: ANU MUNKATSHI MUA BANTU KE MUDI BUKALENGA BUA NZAMBI, KE MUDI MAKALENGA A BANTU MWITA MINENE KUENEZKA MÄ BANTU.

versions.title: ANU MUNKATSHI MUA BANTU KE MUDI BUKALENGA BUA NZAMBI, KE MUDI MAKALENGA A BANTU MWITA MINENE KUENEZKA MÄ BANTU.

lines: Anu munkatshi mua bantu ke mudi bukalenga bua Nzambi ke mudi makalenga a bantu mwita mine kuenezka mu bantu," ke mudi Goliata ne Davidi"(bis)
Mukalenga wa nsamba: Nansha mu makenga, nansha mu disanka, mwita niyalua mu dinda, yoyo niyalua dilolo,
nansha munda nkulu meme ngikala ne muoyo.(bis)
Goliata ekujuka wamba bua bukole wakadi umuluisha anu bua bukalenga," Davidi wamuashi lusoka wa kumi mpala panshi" (bis)
Davidi udi uluishibua mishindu ya bungi, Goliata umuluisha, Shaula ekumuluisha"Shaula wakasanka bualu wakashipa nkama ya bantu,
Davidi wa mutambi wa kokeshi binu nu bia bantu.

hymns.title: BADI BASUE LUPANDU BALUE KUDI YESU

versions.title: BADI BASUE LUPANDU BALUE KUDI YESU

lines: Badi basue lupandu balue kudi Yesu bonso bapete muoyo, bakupuibue mena ku mukanda wa lufu bonso bapete moyo.(bis)
buela, buela, buela, buela: buela, lelu, Yesu udi ukubikila.(bis)
Luaku wewe muntu muteketa ku Di, luaku upete muoyo, Yesu udi ukubikila uye nandi luaku usungidibue.(bis)
Yesu udi wela tshiondo ukubikila luaku upete muoyo, udi ukutangila misangu isatu kayi uku dimuka.(bis)

hymns.title: BADI BAKENGA BUA KUENZA KUA MALU MIMPE BADI NE DISANKA MU NZAMBI

versions.title: BADI BAKENGA BUA KUENZA KUA MALU MIMPE BADI NE DISANKA MU NZAMBI

lines: Badi bakenga bua kuenza kua malu mimpe badi ne disanka mu Nzambi, tunangangana bu bana ba mu Kilisto tuikale ne mishima ya luse (bis)
Wasua kumona moyo ne matuku mimpe; akanda mushima wandi ku malu onso mabi, akebe biandi ditalala adilonde, akanda ludimi luandi kaluambi malu mabi.
Wasua kumona moyo ne matuku mimpe akanda mushima wandi ku malu onso mabi akebe biandi ditalala adilonde akanda mishiku yandi kayambi malu mabi.
Bituenza bonso bu mudi Yepowa musue, nganyi walua kutuenzela bibi; bua lubabu, lukuna, tshiji ne kasungasunga Yepowa Nzambi natuele nyima(bis)
Mayi aa adi tshifuanyi tshia mayi a moyo adi atusungila katataka ki bua divuwa manyanu a mubidi nansha bua dikeba dia moyo kudi Nzambi(bis)

hymns.title: BADI NE MAJITU LUAYI, LUAYI NENU BADI NAWU MANENE MAJITU

versions.title: BADI NE MAJITU LUAYI, LUAYI NENU BADI NAWU MANENE MAJITU

lines: Badi ne majitu luayi : luayi nenu badi nau manene majitu "Yesu udi wamba ne luayi nenu badi nau manene majitu"(bis)
Udi wewe musokome ne majitu ebe, wenda udisua ne majitu ebe.
Dilandi wa tatu wa mamu wa matshi makole, dilandi wa kafua ne majitu panyima dilandi oo wakakenga, muelayi tshibingu;
dilandi wakafua ne majitu eba dilandi oo wakakenga muelayi tshikuabue;
dilandi wakafua ne majitu panyima dilandi oo wakakenga.
Commentaires badi ne buloji, bijanu, masandi

hymns.title: BAFUE BADI BAFUE MU MUKALENGA

versions.title: BAFUE BADI BAFUE MU MUKALENGA

lines: Bafue badi bafue mu mukalenga, bobo badi ne disanka mu Nzambi, bualu lufu luibidi kaluena ne bukokeshi ku mutu kuabo.(bis)
Adieu, adieu, adieu, adieu, adieu, adieu, adieu (bis)
Bu mua kafua kabua Abalahama, Izaka, Yakobo, Josefu ne Mosa; bu mua kafua Yesu muana wa Nzambi, bapositolo bakabajinga bonso. (bis)
Lelu bana betu bonso ndi banjinga lelu mu mukalenga bualu lutu luibidi ntulu kudi bonso ba mu kilisto Yesu.(bis)

hymns.title: BAKAJI BAKAYA BUA KUTANGILA KU LUKITA BAKASANGANA DIBUE DIUMUSHA

versions.title: BAKAJI BAKAYA BUA KUTANGILA KU LUKITA BAKASANGANA DIBUE DIUMUSHA

lines: Bakaji bakaya bua kutangila ku lukita bakasangana dibue diumbusha Yesu kayi momu bakabanga kudila.
"Baka konkangana ne yekelekele nganyi wetu watuleja kua ka mutekabo."(bis)
"Mumana kubika (Yesu wa Nzambi) muye mu Galela netumusangana mulu"
" imbilayi we mukalenga, imbilayi we muna bantu, lelu wa kubikaaaaa lelu wa kubikaaaaaa imbayi tutua tshanga."(bis)
Bakaji bakaya bua kutangila ku lukita ne kujadika tshipungidi tshia meyi a Yesu bakateta kumanya.
"Bakajingulula yekelekele Yesu wetu wakubika mua kadiye wamba."(bis)

hymns.title: BAKANTUMA MEME MU BISAMBA BIA BENDE BUA NGAMBILA BANTU LUMU

versions.title: BAKANTUMA MEME MU BISAMBA BIA BENDE BUA NGAMBILA BANTU LUMU

lines: Bakantuma meme mubisamba bia bende bua ngambila bantu lumu lua bukalenga bua Nzambi."
Bena lukuna banyi kabena bananga badi bakeba moyo wanyi bua mpanga mudimu"(bis)
Mudimu wa Nzambi wa misumba, mudimu udi munene, ba wenji kabena koku bakadi bakese
"kadi nuenu bakawitabuja lelu nualekedi (mudimu) malua udi minuindile kudi Yehova"(bis)
Patuvua mu tshipela ne Mose wa Nzambi nyoka yakasuma bantu babungi bakafua
"wewe muanetu tangila kulu kudi nyoka wa Mose udi usungila bantu"(bis)
Mu bualu bua Nzambi mudianu makenga mudi ntatu ne lufu bionso bidi bikuindile,
kolesha mutshima jukula kilisto bua munya utema bantu batumbisha Nzambi" (bis)

hymns.title: BAKASHIPA BA PROPHETA NE BA POSTOLO BA YESU

versions.title: BAKASHIPA BA PROPHETA NE BA POSTOLO BA YESU

lines: Bakashipa ba Profeta ne ba Postolo ba Yesu " anu bua Dî dia Nzambi dia musungidi wetu"(bis)
" nfumu Yesu wakela Dî Eloi Eloi ", " Lamasabakatani tatu wanyi", " wakundekela nkenga bua dina diebe",
" nditeka muoyo wanyi mu bianza bianza biebe", " tatu ubafue luse ki bamanya bualu"(bis)
" Lukuna lua Heloda Yesu udi ujinga Yelushalema", " wewa Yelushalema udi ushipa baprofeta", "nakadi musue kusungila bana bandi"(bis)
" Lufu lua Yesu kilisto muana wa Nzambi" , " midima yakakuata buloba bujima","diulu buloba biakazakala kumpala kua Nzambi"(bis)

hymns.title: BAKAYA NE YESU KILISTO MUDIAMBUILA MUTSHI WANDI

versions.title: BAKAYA NE YESU KILISTO MUDIAMBUILA MUTSHI WANDI

lines: Bakaya ni Yesu kilisto mu diambuila mutshi wandi mutshiamakana bakamupopa milonda mu bianza minga mu makasa, baka mupopa pamua ne banyengi"
Yesu kayi ne bualu yoyoyo bakamupopa".
bakaya nandi mu tshiota muhola ni muoyo wa munda, baya mu bena Nzambi muhola ni muoyo wa munda, mu balunda basanga muhola ni muoyo wa munda.
Bamutua difuma mu muoyo mayi ne mashi biapatuka" Yesu kayi ne bualu yoyoyo baka mupopa" (bis)
Yesu kilisto ufuafua ne malu kayi? Ne malu mabi a pa buloba: tshiendenda tshia malunda mabi apa buloba, bundu ne bowa, makenga ne masama
" malu apa buloba yoyoyo mafue kudiye".
Kua kashipelabo Yesu kilisto kulu kua mutshi masalayi akangata bilamba, bilamba bia Yesu bakabanyangana,
tshikowelu bakatshielela nshobo" Yesu kayi mubanda yoyoyo nganyi wa tshivuala".

hymns.title: BAKESE NE BAYA MU DIULU BUA DITABUIA DIA MUANA NZAMBI

versions.title: BAKESE NE BAYA MU DIULU BUA DITABUIA DIA MUANA NZAMBI

lines: Bakese ne baya mu diulu bua ditabuia dia muana Nzambi. (bis)
Aba bantu bakabenga kuitabuia Yesu nebele muadi kudi nfumu "nebambene tuwa tukuenzela mudimu webe aleluya. (bis)
Babungi ne badila muadi bua bupote buabo aleluya. (bis)
Tuendayi badimuka mu njila bua ba profeta ba mashimi. Nebalue kutudi baluata ne biseba bia mikoko. (bis)

hymns.title: BALA MUKANDA WA NZAMBI UDIFILA KUDIU NE BUKOLE

versions.title: BALA MUKANDA WA NZAMBI UDIFILA KUDIU NE BUKOLE

lines: Bala mukanda wa Nzambi udifila kudiu ne bukoleeee ; umone malu akukema be. (bis)
" (lombayi) : lombayi Nzambi" satana muimane vuluka mutshi mutshiamakane (bis)
Matayo, Mako, Luka, Yone, Bienzedi, Lomo, bena Kolintoooo, Galatia, bena Efeso. (bis)
Filipoyi, Kolosayi, Tesalonika, Timote ne Titotoo, filemona bena Ebelu. (bis)
Yakobo, Petelo, Yone, Yuda, Buakabuluibua mukanda wa kunshikidilu. (bis)

hymns.title: BALUNDA BANYI BAKASHIDI BANVUA NGENDA NABU MU MOSE.

versions.title: BALUNDA BANYI BAKASHIDI BANVUA NGENDA NABU MU MOSE.

lines: Balunda banyi bakatshidi bavua ngenda nabu mu Mose bakadi benza bu bena mupongo bonso bamona binama, bakupa mitu banyingalala bamba nakutshibamkana.
"Yepowa Nzambi ungakidile".(bis)
(wamaya) buloba bunyanguke, bijanu biakona buloba, buloba bunyanguke;
masandi akona buloba, buloba bunyanguke; buloji buakona buloba,
Nzambi nkuata ku tshianza tshianyi ungakidile, "betuabue yoyoyo mu dina dia mukalenga."
Maalu onso a pa buloba nakaenze ekuenzulula, tshiakapeta tshintu mu malu aa, tshia kapeta moyo
Mu malu aa. "Anu dikenga anu malu aa ditalala kadiyi pa buloba"bis, "Yepowa Nzambi ungakidile" (bis)
Meme tshiena mua kutumbila ku muanda mukuabu pa buloba anu ku mutshi mutshamakana wa Yesu muana mukalenga,
"kua katshipelabu malu aa, meme nakafua ku maalu aa". "Yepowa Nzambi ungakidile" (bis)

hymns.title: BALUNDA TUDIKONKE TUDIKONKE NE TUETU ABA TUDI BA MUSHOTA KAYI.

versions.title: BALUNDA TUDIKONKE TUDIKONKE NE TUETU ABA TUDI BA MUSHOTA KAYI.

lines: Balunda tudikonke tudikonke ne tetu aba tudi ba mutshiota kayi?
Patutshidi tudifuila mua satana mu nkanu ya kakosa muana Nzambi.(bis)
Kilisto wakamana kulua wa watupikula, wakalua ne budishi kaminyi watupa moyo,
nunku tuetu tudijadika bua katupinganyi muinshi muatshikokedi tshialufu ne tshia satana. (bis)
Yehowa wakatamba kutunanga, Kilisto wakalua ne wakatufuila. (bis)

hymns.title: BAMBI BA NZAMBI BAMBI NUATULAMA BIMPA, MOSE WAKAPANGILA MULAYI.

versions.title: BAMBI BA NZAMBI BAMBI NUATULAMA BIMPA, MOSE WAKAPANGILA MULAYI.

lines: Bambi ba Nzambi bambi nuatulama bimpa, Mosa wakapangila mulayi. (x2)
Tulondayi Yepowa, Yepowa, Yepowa Tulondayi Yesu netusungidibua.
Tulondayi Yepowa, Yepowa, Yepowa Tulondayi diyi netusungidibua.
Nzambi natupa midimu ituvua tukeba kadi kuvenza kudi kukole. Nzambi natupa midimu utudi tukeba kadi kuvenza kudi kukole.
Nzambi natupa bintu bitudi tukeba kadi kulama kudi kukole.(bis)

hymns.title: BANA BAKAJI BA MU YELUSHALEMA BAVUA BENDA BALONDA YESU BENDA BADILA MUADI

versions.title: BANA BAKAJI BA MU YELUSHALEMA BAVUA BENDA BALONDA YESU BENDA BADILA MUADI

lines: Bana bakaji ba mu Yelushalema bavua benda balonda Yesu benda badila muadi
" Yesu ku bambila kanundidi meme nudila bualu buenu ne bua bana benu" (bis)
nudi nundonda anu bua kudia anu bua kunua balunda, bua kuenza mudi Nzambi musua kanuena bananga
" disanka didi kudi muntu udi weyemena Nzambi" (bis)
Lufu lua Yesu midima yakenza tshilamba tshia mu ntempelo tshia kapandika
" wakela Di eyi tatu wanyi ndi NSFU mUOYU wanyi mu bianza bieba" (bis)
Yesu kubika dinda dia lumingu wakamueneka kudi Malia wa mu Magdala
"pakunvuabo ne Yesu wakubika wakamueneka kudi Malia kabakitabuia" (bis)

hymns.title: BANA BA YOBO BAKAJIKA BONSO BANA BALUMA MUANDA MUTEKETA

versions.title: BANA BA YOBO BAKAJIKA BONSO BANA BALUMA MUANDA MUTEKETA

lines: Bana ba yobo bakajika bonso bana baluma muandamuteketa, basatu ba bakaji bonso kafua meme nkayanyi nakushala bua ku kuambila(bis)
Yobo wetu wakenga, Yobo wakenga muna mputa mu mutu biwuja mubidi mujima, yobo wetu wakenga waka dikuanya ne tshiyoyi (bis)
Mukaji wa Yobo wajinga bana, mukaji wa yobo wa kajinga mpunda, wa kambila Yobo, Yobo benga Nzambi tumuna bimuna tumelu, ngomba ne mpunda(bis)
Kadi Yobo wetu waka muambula ne udi wakula bu mukaji mupote, ngitabuja Nzambi anu bua masanka tshitabuji Yehowa bua makenga kabidi anyi? (bis)

hymns.title: BANA BA YAKOBO DIKUMI NE BABIDI BAKAPANA JOSEFU MU EJIPITU

versions.title: BANA BA YAKOBO DIKUMI NE BABIDI BAKAPANA JOSEFU MU EJIPITU

lines: Bana ba Yakobo dikumi ne babidi bakapana Josefu mu Ejipitu ku palata yabo makumi abidi bua butumbi buabo Josefu wakaya" (bis)
Mukalenga Palo wakela muadi mukole eyi tatu wanyi umfuile luse
"bukalenga buanyi naku bupa Josefu ashala mukokeshi wa buloba bujima"
Josefu mu mpala wa mukalenga Palo wakamauaila bilota biandi bionso
"mukalenga wanyi lupingu wewe bakubala mukalenga buebe bonso"(bis)
Mu bilota bikuabu bia bena Ejipitu bia ngomba midiunda minga minyana,
"wewe muanetu mu bukalenga bueba newikale mudiunda anyi munyana"(bis)

hymns.title: BANA BETU BA MU YESU TUKOLESHA MITSHIMA

versions.title: BANA BETU BA MU YESU TUKOLESHA MITSHIMA

lines: Bana betu ba mu Yesu, tukolesha mitshima katushinyi bua makenga Nzambi ne ikala netu. (bis)
(Ya) Yadene bukola buetu, (ya) Yadena mioyo yetu.(bis)
(Tuetu) netusabuke Yadena, ne mioyo yetu bimpe.(bis)
Mona Alona kabidi mukuatshishi wa Mosa, bua kudienzela kua maalu, wakafua bulela, wa kafuila mu tshipela ku kala kua Yadena (bis)
Kadi wewe muena bupidia ne ubuelemu anyi, Anu biwikala ne dina ku mukanda wa moyo. (bis)

hymns.title: BANA BETU BANANGA, LUAYI LUAYI NUMONE, DIALELU DITUKU DIA KUSOMBA MU MATUTU

versions.title: BANA BETU BANANGA, LUAYI LUAYI NUMONE, DIALELU DITUKU DIA KUSOMBA MU MATUTU

lines: Bana betu bananga luayi luayi numone " dia lelu dituku dia kusomba mu matutu " (bis)
Dia kuangata mulayi ne nyuma wa mukalenga " dia lelu dituku dia kusomba mu matutu " (bis)
Pa buloba badi pabi we tshiena nsomba pa buloba" dia lelu dituku dia kusomba mu matutu " (bis)
Nyaya kasombe la mu diulu mu nyuma wa mukalenga " dia lelu dituku dia kusomba mu matutu " (bis)
Lekelayi lubombo (buloji) bua nupe te mulayi " dia lelu dituku dia kusomba mu matutu " (bis)
Angata dinanga bua nuya nadi mu bantu " dia lelu dituku dia kusomba mu matutu " (bis)

hymns.title: BANA BETU TUMUSHAYI MPATA BU YA BANTU BA KALE BAKADI KABAYI BATELEJA WA MISUMBA

versions.title: BANA BETU TUMUSHAYI MPATA BU YA BANTU BA KALE BAKADI KABAYI BATELEJA WA MISUMBA

lines: Bana betu tumbushayi mpata bu ya bantu bakale "bakadi kabayi bateleja wa mismba Nzambi wabo" (bis)
Pakaloka nvula: "bena buloji (bena masandi...) bakafua mu mai manene Nzambi wabo" (bis)
Nzambi wakambila Noa, Noa songa buatu ne ndokesha nvula " bakadi kabayi mua kudila ne badile Nzambi wabo" (bis)
Nuenu bakuetu suayi bua nuyile diyisha dilelela " nupeta dimanya dilelela mu mitshima nusungidibue" (bis)

hymns.title: BANJELU BADI MU DIULU BADI BA MUTUMBISHA

versions.title: BANJELU BADI MU DIULU BADI BA MUTUMBISHA

lines: Banjelo badi mu diulu badi ba mutumbisha, kadi wewe pa buloba utshidi mue na tshiendenda.
Yehowa wanyi mufuki tatu wakaya biandi mu diulu wa kangata dinga diulu bua kufuka nandi dikuabu,
wakambila nyunyi ya mulu ne nyunyi inyunge, bia nyunga nyunyi ya mulu buloba busanke. (bis)
Bunene yoyoyo, bunene bua Yehowa","bena Isalela bakabuelawe, kubuela mu Kanana",
bavua bela mpungi ya disanka we kubuela mu Kanana
Mose wakaya mu mpata Moaba,"ku mikuna ya Nebo ne Pisega,"mitangilangana ne Yeleko,
baka muleja buloba bonso bua" Gilada ne Dana ne Nafatala, "Efelayima, Manashe, Yuda (bis)

hymns.title: BANJELU BAKAYA BUA KUSUNGILA LOTA

versions.title: BANJELU BAKAYA BUA KUSUNGILA LOTA

lines: Benjelo bakaya bua kusungila Lota apatuka mu Sodomo mu masanka a panshi, apatuka mu dikenga abuela mu disanka
" muadi ne uikaleku ne kusumakaja kua menu." (bis)
kudi tshikondo tshia makenga ne tshia masanka, Yesu wa Nzambi ulue;
utusungile ne nyuma muimpe alue atusamba tetu ne tupeta moyo.
Lota wakabambila luayi kuneku balunda, nubuele mu nzubu nulalamu butuku, nubuela mu nzubu emu nulala butuku, " wa kabenzela bidia kabiyi luevena " (bis)
Wewe muntu wa Nzambi kuikadi wenza bu Lota, " ba mutuma ku mikuna ukasomba mu sowa" " wakabuela mu lubuebue wa kalelamu bana"
" bana bakadi tshilumbu luidi ne dipila " (bis)

hymns.title: BANJELO BABIDI BAKAYA MU MUSOKO WA SODOMA NE AMOLA BUA KUSUNGILA LOTA.

versions.title: BANJELO BABIDI BAKAYA MU MUSOKO WA SODOMA NE AMOLA BUA KUSUNGILA LOTA.

lines: Banjelo babidi bakaya mu musoko wa Sodoma ne Amola bua ku sungila Lota. "Lota wakadi ushikama ku tshibi tshia musoko" (bis)
nganyi uanyi wa nsungila pantshidi mu musoko anu Yehowa Nzambi Yeye wa bukola bonso,
yeye wa kansungila mu Sodoma ne Amola, yeye wa kampatulamumasankaa panshi. (bis)
Lota wakababikila, kubabueja mu nzubu, nulate butuku nuvuwe makasa "ne nubi ke mudinda nenuye mu njila wenu" (bis)
Mukaji wa Lota wakatangila ku nyima pakadibo baya batangila ku mikuna "mukaji eu waka ndamuka kulua dibue dia luepu " (bis)

hymns.title: BANTU BA MU TSHIKONDO ETHI BADI BADISUA YOYI NE MALU MABI

versions.title: BANTU BA MU TSHIKONDO ETHI BADI BADISUA YOYI NE MALU MABI

lines: " Bantu ba mu tshikondo badi badiswa yoiwe ne maalu mabi" "Yesu nabambila nenu numbuke kundi mema tshiena munumanya"
"bananga kadi muadi : Yoyoiuwe muadi (x3), ba nuambila meme tshiena munumanya." (bis)
" Mulunda wanyi yoyoyo kunangidi bua masanka makese " " masanka maangi yoyoyo adi mu diulu mua tatu Nzambi "
Tulonda Yesu wa Nzambi tupeta dietu difutu dia tshiendelela (bis)

hymns.title: BANTU BA SODOMA NE AMOLA BAKAPIDIA NZAMBI

versions.title: BANTU BA SODOMA NE AMOLA BAKAPIDIA NZAMBI

lines: " Bantu ba Sodomo ne Amola bakapidia Nzambi " " Nzambi wabo, Nzambi wabo, wa disanka, wa lusa be eyo." (bis)
Nzambi wa kamba ne Ngosha Sodomo, meme ; ne ngosha Sodomo, meme ; ne ngosha Amola,
" Sodomo we, Sodomo ne Amola bakapidia Nzambi" (bis)
(Wewe), wewe tatu we mamu wewe, wewe songalume "biwikale mu Sodomo ne oshiue bushuwa" (bis).
Wewe muambi wa Nzambi wa Nzambi tumbisha Nzambi weba, "biwaluja mesu pa nyima ne ulwe dibua dia luepu" (bis).

hymns.title: BANTU BADIANU BAMANYA BIMANYINU BIA NVULA KADI KABENA BAMANYA BIA BUKALENGA BUA NZAMBI

versions.title: BANTU BADIANU BAMANYA BIMANYINU BIA NVULA KADI KABENA BAMANYA BIA BUKALENGA BUA NZAMBI

lines: Bantu badianu bamanya bimanyinu bia nvula "kadi kabena bamanya bia bukalenga bua Nzambi"(bis)
" Yehowa wanyi mukalenga wanyi bimanyinu bieba bilenga" " bimanyinu bieba bilengela muanza nkongolokulu "
Nudi nutangila kulu ; numona matutu koku, numona diulu dikunza, " nenu kumba kuela divi nvula nya ukadi wiya"(bis)
Mpala wa diulu ne wa buloba bidi munda mua tatu kanuena bamanya yoyoyo bia bukalenga bua Nzambi"(bis)

hymns.title: BANTU BONSO BA PA BULOBA TELEJA NUNWE

versions.title: BANTU BONSO BA PA BULOBA TELEJA NUNWE

lines: Bantu bonso ba pa buloba teleja nunvua; tudi tufuma mu diulu mua tatu Nzambi,
bakangata nyuma muimpe bua bualu buenu, nsungulayi tshidi mua kuenza nulekela manga,
nsungulayi tshidi mua kuenza nulekela maloji. (bis)
" nunku Nzambi kutuma diyi ; ambilayi bantu balekale manga, ambilayi bantu balekayi maloji".
" Kadi yoyoyoyo tatu lekela lubombo, yoyoyoyo mamu lekela bijanu,
yoyoyoyo tatu nganyi wa kukonka, yoyoyoyo mamu wewa ne bakoshe." (bis)
Badi basue bua kuitabuja telejayi nunvue ; tuvua bakangata nsapi ya tshibi tshia diulu ;
bua kukanga ne kunzulula ku mioyo yenu ayi, nsungulayi tshidi mua kuenza nulekela manga,
nsungulayi tshidi mua kuenza nulekela maloji. (bis)
tuakapueka ne tshimanyinu tshia nkutshi mu mioyo, nyunyi wa nkutshi kakapweka pa nyama ya lonji, " itabuja nyuma abuele mu mu ts h i m a w e b a " (b i s )

hymns.title: BANTU WETU KUAMBILA KUDILA NE MUADI, KUNUBELA MU DINDA TOO NE MU DILOLO

versions.title: BANTU WETU KUAMBILA KUDILA NE MUADI, KUNUBELA MU DINDA TOO NE MU DILOLO

lines: Bantu wetu kuambila kudila ne muadi, ku nubela mu dinda to ne mu dilolo " nusungule yoyoyo tshinudi mua kuenza" (bis)
Bantu wetu kuambila kudila ne muadi, nuenu bantu nudi basue lufu anyi muoyo " nusungule yoyoyo tshinudi mua kuenza" (bis)
Tshiunvuidi tshienu tshidi penyi, tshidi penyiwe " waka nubikila
yoyoyo kanuyi mua kuitaba" (bis)
Diba ne dilue ditua kabingishiube " waka nubikila yoyoyo kanuyi mua kuitaba" (bis)

hymns.title: BA WAKUPESHA BUKOKESHI LUVUNGULU LUA DIULU

versions.title: BA WAKUPESHA BUKOKESHI LUVUNGULU LUA DIULU

lines: Bawakupesha bukokeshi luvungulu lua diulu bua kukanga ne bua kunzulula ne ku muaba wa bafue;
tshiasuika bu panshi tshiasuikabu mu diulu kudi Yehowa; tshia sululabu panshi tshia sululabu mu diulu kudi Yehowa. (bis)
Nkudi mbayeba ya buki mulu ne nkutshi yeba yabuki mulu, yatangalaki mu luepeela yendai pepela
"yendai kilabadi nebamu bobumue bua bapeta muoyo" betuabu betuabu bana balume ba mukalenga,
betuabu betuabu nuenu bilobo bia mukalenga, betuabu betuabu minyampala ya mukalenga
Nfumu wetu Yesu musungidi wa kamu pa bukola bua kutamba nyuma ya bukoya kuyumusha mu bantu, kujikija masama ne mateketa bia mishindu ya bungi. (bis)
Betuabu mu dina dia tatu tunaudi betuabu, betuabu mu dina dia muana tunaudi betuabu,
betuabu mu dina dia nyuma tunaudi betuabu"betuabu betuabu mu dina dia mukalenga"(bis)

hymns.title: BENA ISALELA BAKADI NE MOSA KUBENGA YEPOWA KULONDA BALA

versions.title: BENA ISALELA BAKADI NE MOSA KUBENGA YEPOWA KULONDA BALA

lines: Bena Isalela bakadi ne Mose kubenga Yehowa kulonda bala Nzambi wa bisamba bia bende kabayi mua kumanya(bis)
Tudi bavuala tshifulu tshimpe, tudi bakuata dikombo dia bukalenga. tudi basomba mu nkuasa lelu, tudi bavuala tshilamba tshia bukalenga. (bis)
Nuena bana betu nubenga bua nyuma, nupidia Dî " bananga mianda ne maluba biobio kabiyi ne difutu" (bis)
Nzambi wa misumba mubenga midima, muanyisha munya " munyoka, badi ne mahaha kabayi ne mesu nansha " (bis)

hymns.title: BENA ISALELA BASABUKI YADENA LELU

versions.title: BENA ISALELA BASABUKI YADENA LELU

lines: "Bena Isalela basabuka Yadena lelu an an eyowe an yoyoyo, tshina musheta londa musheta panyima an an eyowe an yoyoyo,
shila musheta muaba pa nkatshi coude binunu bibidi an an eyowe an yoyoyo.(bis)
(Katonkola) waya katonkola dieba dibue ne ukonka nganyi tatu wanyi we,
dianyi diashadi bu mumanyi wa bualu pankatshi petu neba we, Yoshua wimanyiki dibue bu mutshi wa telebinta.(bis)
Bua kusabuka Yadena tuimane balulama mu Yadena an an eyowe an yoyoyo,
muntu ne muntu angula dibua dienda mu Yadena, an an eyowe an yoyoyo, tuyaya kuluangana mvita ne Yeleko an an eyowe an yoyoyo.
"Bakuidi batuala musheta wa tshipungidi tshia mei a Yehowa an an eyowe an yoyoyo,
bimana balulama mu lusenga luma mu Yadena an an eyowe an yoyoyo, bonso basabuku mu lusenga luma ku makasa an an eyowe an yoyoyo.

hymns.title: BENA ISALELA BAYIDI BU MUWAABU BANTU, KABAVUA MUA KUMONA NZAMBI BOBU KUSHALA NE MOYI NANSHA

versions.title: BENA ISALELA BAYIDI BU MUWAABU BANTU, KABAVUA MUA KUMONA NZAMBI BOBU KUSHALA NE MOYI NANSHA

lines: Bena Isalela bayidi, bu muwaabu bantu, ka bavua mua kumona Nzambi; bobu kushala ne moyi nansha.(bis)
(Kopolayì): kanu ya bakaji benu, ni ya bana balela idi ku mashi kuabo,
meme ne nduizela muana wa ngomba, nu mutendelela bu mudi meji enu. (disua dienu) (bis)
kanulengi tshianza ku mukuna bua kanufu nansha bu bobo balenga Sinayi , bonso buabo bavua bava lubifu. (bis)
Pakabanda Mosa ku mukuna, bena Isalela Alona utuenzela kana ka ngomba kikala ku mitu yetu.(bis)
Pakapenda Nzambi wa moyo, bakajana Mose, Alona utuenzela Nzambi idi mua kuya kumpala kuetu.(bis)

hymns.title: BENA ISALELA KUDIBUEJA MU BUPIKA BUA PALO, PAKAPANABU MUANABU MENEN YOSEFU DI DIA NZAMBI

versions.title: BENA ISALELA KUDIBUEJA MU BUPIKA BUA PALO, PAKAPANABU MUANABU MENEN YOSEFU DI DIA NZAMBI

lines: Bena Isalela kudibueja mu bupika bua Palo, pakapanabo muan’abo mene Yosefu Di dia Nzambi.(bis)
Biwiikale mumana kupana Di dia Nzambi webe, bua kudipeta neukenga be neudila ne muadi.(bis)
Nzambi kunvuaye miadi yabo kubatumina Mose, buakubapatula mu bupika kumpala kua nfumu palo.(bis)
Mose pakadiye mu tshipela udisha mu mikoko, wakamona katshi kakuata kapia, wakasemena pepi.(bis)
Wakunvua Di mukatshi aku kudi Yehowa Nzambi, umusha bilatu ku makasa muabaeu wa tshijila.(bis)

hymns.title: BENA KILISTO BAKENGA BUMUAKAKENGA YESU MUANA

versions.title: BENA KILISTO BAKENGA BUMUAKAKENGA YESU MUANA

lines: Bena kilisto bakenga bu mua kakenga Yesu muana. kanukemi bualu bua dikenga didi bu kapia munkantshi muenu,
diakulua kunudi buditeta, diakulua bu bualu bupiabupia, nuabany angina bonso makenga nutendelela Nzambi wenu.(bis)
Muena lukuna wetu satana udi wendakana bu Ntambua ukungula ukeba bia kudia tumutantamena bonso bikole. (bis)
Bianupendabu bua dina dianyi nudi ne disanka bualu bua nyuma, nyuma wa butumbi nyuma wa Nzambi utuwikala pa mbidi penu.
Umua wenu kakengeshibue bu mushipianganyi bu muivi anyi bu muenji wa bubi bonso mu dibueja mu malu a bantu.(bis)
Binualua bena lukunukunu lua kuenza kua malu mimpe kanulondi diyisha dikuabu anu dia kanushila kilisto,
ne nuasa tshifulu tshimpe ne nuluata tshilamba tshipiatshipia, nenusombela bonso kumesa amukalenga Yesu kilisto.(bis)

hymns.title: BENA KILISTO TSHISAMBA TSHIA YEPOWA NZAMBI

versions.title: BENA KILISTO TSHISAMBA TSHIA YEPOWA NZAMBI

lines: Bena Kilisto tshisamba tshia Yepowa Nzambi, tuenzela Nzambi wetu mudimu ne disanka, tunangangana bonso, dinanga diende dimueka mu bantu.(bis)
Tunanganganayi balunda betu, tuleke bijanu ne ku disua munda, nudi nuenda ne biambamba, buena Nzamba budi kuepi,
nudi nuenda ne bienzenza, buena Nzamba budi kuepi, tulekayi kuna, ne biji, tukuatayi mudimu, tudi bana ba muntu, tuikalayi bamue",
Ekelezia eu ki ngueba ki wanyi, ki ngua muntu , "tujukayi tuenzelayi Nzambi mudimu,"
Bena kilisto Tshisamba tshia Yepowa wa Nzambi, tuenzelayi Nzambi wetu budimu ne disanka, tunangangana bonso basangila po pamue mu dinanga.(bis)
Butuikala ne dinanga dia Yepowa Nzambi, ne tumuizela mudimu mu tua kadi kale ka muyi kasungasunga nansha ditapuluka bananga. (bis)

hymns.title: BENA KILISTO TUVULUKAYI BUA MITSHIIPU ITUA KADITSHIPA

versions.title: BENA KILISTO TUVULUKAYI BUA MITSHIIPU ITUA KADITSHIPA

lines: Bena kilisto tuvulukayi; bua mitshipu itua kaditshipa, "kumpala kua Yesu masiya ne kua bena Ekelezia"(bis)
Muena bijila, muena ndondo, bi walama bijila bimpe, kadi bi upula bijila, ndodo ne iku kuate, kadi bi upula bijila ne ufue bulela. (bis)
Tuenzayi mudimu wetu bimpe ku mesu kua Yepowa Nzambi; "ka uikadi ne biabamba ne dielangana mpata"
Tuakadishipa bua mudimu eu kuela diyi dikole ne; " ne tuenzela Nzambi mudimu too ne ku lufu luetu. "

hymns.title: BENA KUITABUJA NUADIMUKA BIENU BUA KULONDA YESU MUANA NZAMBI

versions.title: BENA KUITABUJA NUADIMUKA BIENU BUA KULONDA YESU MUANA NZAMBI

lines: "Bena kuitabuja nuadimuka bienu bua kulonda Yesu muana Nzambi", watufuile, watusungile ku mibi yetu, yeye ke lupandu.
wa manya anu mua kulonda anu Yesu muana wa Nzambi, bituamulonda neatuvuia anu bonso bayidi bandi,
ne yeye wakamba Di ne ndayi nuvuia bonso ba mu bisamba bonso bayidi bandi nu ndonda meme. (bis)
" Banga bakitaba bobo kumulonda Yesu udi nabo mu makenga"; nabasamba nabasungile ku mibi yabo, yeye ke lupandu.
"Munzubu emu lelu badi batuyisha bua kulonda Yesu muana Nzambi", tumulonde mu mioyo yetu muana wa Nzambi yeye ke lupandu.

hymns.title: BENA MUPONGO NE BENA MANGA BAMBA NE BAKENGESHA

versions.title: BENA MUPONGO NE BENA MANGA BAMBA NE BAKENGESHA

lines: Bena muhongo ne bena manga bamba ne bakengesha " mibidi yetu an eyowe anu Nzambi udi netu"(bis)
Nganyi muntu na nyenga muoyo mulama mu tshianza tshia Nzambi " Nansha kakese an eyowe anu Nzambi udi netu"(bis)
Biwashindama kudi Nzambi webe ne muoyo webe mukezuke " ne kudi Yesu kakuena muntu panu wakuenzela bualu"

hymns.title: BENA NZAMBI TUDIKONKE, TUDIKONKE, TUDIKONKE

versions.title: BENA NZAMBI TUDIKONKE, TUDIKONKE, TUDIKONKE

lines: Bena Nzambi tudikonke, tudikonke, tudikonke, ne tudi bakana lelu ku mesu kua Nzambi wa moyo. (bis)
Bena Nzambi tudikonke, tudikonke, tudikonke, ne tudi bakana lelu ku mesu kua Nzambi wa moyo.(bis)
Bena Nzambi tudikonke, tudikonke, tudikonke, ne tudi bakana lelu ku mesu kua Nzambi wa moyo.(bis)

hymns.title: BENA PELESHETA BA KUNYENGA MUSHETA WA TSHIPUNGIDI TSHIA MEYI A YEHOWA

versions.title: BENA PELESHETA BA KUNYENGA MUSHETA WA TSHIPUNGIDI TSHIA MEYI A YEHOWA

lines: Bena Pelesheta ba kunyenga musheta wa tshipungidi tshia meyi a Yehowa, bayi kauteka mu Ebeneza, mu Ashidodo, mu nzubu wa Dakona.(bis)
Ngomba nyia kuhingaja musheta wa Yehowa wa misumba mu njila yenda idila eyi musheta wahinganyi.(bis)
Ba kunyenga musheta wa meyi a Yehowa, wa mwena Isalela wa kenda ku makasa, ba kafuila mu mvita bu binunu binayi ne bana ba Eli Ofine ne Pinehaza. (bis)
Bena Pelesheta koleshayi mitshima, nutantamane nuikala ne musheta, kanuikadi bahika ba bena Ebelu, bena Isalela bikala bahika benu. (bis)

hymns.title: BENYAMINA WETU TUTUMBISHIYAYI YEPOWA BUA TUAPESHI DȊ WA LUNGENYI NE MEJI

versions.title: BENYAMINA WETU TUTUMBISHIYAYI YEPOWA BUA TUAPESHI DȊ WA LUNGENYI NE MEJI

lines: Benyamina wetu tutumbishiyayi Yepowa "hua tuapeshi Di wa lungenyi ne meji" (bis)
Benyamina tuakulua ku mukuna wa tshijila udibo babikila mu bena Ebelo Yepowa ile "Yepowa neatupa bintu" (bis)
Benyamina wetu tutumbishiayyi Yepowa "bua tuapeshi nyuma wa lungenyi ne meji"(bis)

hymns.title: BETANIYA UDI MUSOKO WA MATA NE MALIA NE MUANABO LAZALO

versions.title: BETANIYA UDI MUSOKO WA MATA NE MALIA NE MUANABO LAZALO

lines: Betania udi musoko wa Mata ne Malia ne muanabo Lazalo, " uditshilejelu tshia muntu udi ne meji a mubidi, udi ne meji a Nzambi ne muoyo wa tshiendelela".
" Lazalo m uena dikenga balunda ne m uena lufu utudi tuenda tukengesha" tudi tuenda tudiundisha muoyo mukese wa pa buloba Lazalo uenda utapika.
"Bantu muamoniwe lukuka luenu bananga ke ludi lunushipa" (bis)
Mona meji a mubidi aka kengesha Lazalo amu tapa ne mputa " pavua mubanji ku mesa Lazalo uvua pambelu uvua udia anu nkototo mbuya yaka mulaka wafua".
Bana betu bena Nzambi Malia asomba ku mesa Lazalo adie anue asanke " biasomba Mata ku mesa uvuluka bua mubanji pakamonaye Lazalo mu tshiadi tshia Abalahama".

hymns.title: BETESEDA MPOKOLO WA TSHIJILA

versions.title: BETESEDA MPOKOLO WA TSHIJILA

lines: Beteseda mpokolo wa nfumu Beteseda mpokolo wa tshijila Yepowa wakatuma muanjelo wandi bua kuvuandululaye mpokolo(bis)
"Bika mukuetu ambula" Bika mukuetu ambula bulalu endaku (bis)
Kuakadi muntu umue mukuabo uvua muikale ne disama dianyi bidimu makumi asatu ne muanda mukulu wakondopibue kudi nfumu Yesu (bis)
Nuenu bafofo bikaba bena mapapa nusemenayi kudi muntu wawa yeye udi utua bantu mu mpokolo pa tshidi mayi avuanduluka (bis)

hymns.title: BIALOPOKA NYUMA WA BUKOYA MUNDA MUA MUNTU

versions.title: BIALOPOKA NYUMA WA BUKOYA MUNDA MUA MUNTU

lines: Bialopoka nyuma wa bukoya munda mua muntu "uyaya wenda wendakana ukeba muaba wa kuikisha",
"biapangaye kumona muaba udi wamba mundamunda ne mpingane mu nzubu wanyi unakalopoka"(bis)
"difu dia kakutuala didi ne disanka ne mabela awakamua a mamu webe"
badi bateleja Dî badi ba dilama bobo ne basombe ku mesa ne Yesu, badi bateleja Dî badi ba dilama bobo ne bavuale tshilamba ne Yesu. (bis)
" Bialuaye kusangana nzubu mumana kukomba", " udi walukila udi wa ngata nyuma muanda muteketa",
"idi ibuela idi ishikama mu nzubu muayi ", " malu a muntu adi apita adiambedi bubi " (bis)

hymns.title: BIFUKIBUA BIONSO MALU MU DUILU

versions.title: BIFUKIBUA BIONSO MALU MU DUILU

lines: Bifukibua bionso mulu mu diulu ku nkuasa wa butumbi " bidi bimba hozana bitumbisha mukalenga" (bis)
" dia kumbanyi diba dia kumuelela mbilela" Nzambi tatu ij akue anu tuwija Paradizo buloba bulengela,
Yesu muana iyakue anu tuangata mu matutu ne tuya neba mu lupepela,
nyuma muimpe iyakue an ne busambi bua kulu kutudi tuetu kashidi ne tshiendelela.(bis)
Bakulu bonso ma kumi abidi ne banai ku nkuasa wa butumbi "badi bimba hozana batumbisha mukalenga"(bis)
Banjelo bonso mulu mu diulu ku nkuasa wa butumbi " badi bimba hozana batumbisha mukalenga"(bis)
Tshishikula tshimue mbombo inai binunu binai ku nkuasa wa butumbi " badi bimba hozana batumbisha mukalenga"(bis)

hymns.title: BIKONDO BIA BUNYI BIA KUPITA NAKADI MUJIMINA

versions.title: BIKONDO BIA BUNYI BIA KUPITA NAKADI MUJIMINA

lines: Bikondo bia bunyi bia kupita nakadi mujima, Yepowa Nzambi, Nzambi wanyi wewa kudenkedi too, mpideu meme ndi sanka bua kupingana kudi.(bis)
tulomba, lomba tulomba, lomba bukole netulomba bukole bupueke bua kutamba nabo satana.
Tujile tujila tujila yoyoyo tudila muadi muadi dilayi Nzambi wetu utupesha ditalala.
Nenu ba tatu ba Nzambi ne ba mamu wanyi ne bana , tudi basungidibue ku ngasa wa mukalenga Yesu(bis)
Nuelayi meji bia kupiana mutshi wa nfumu wetu Yesu ,wa piana mutshi neapeta mutshi wa nfumu wetu Yesu(bis)

hymns.title: BIOMBELU EBI BIA MU DILU

versions.title: BIOMBELU EBI BIA MU DILU

lines: Biombelu ebi bia mu diulu ne bia pa buloba" bia kutumbisha nabio Nzambi bua butumbi buende" (bis)
nunku ne tubuele mu kanana Nzambi wanyi mua kabuela bankambua".
mu kanana muakabuela bankambua: mu kanana yoyoyo mua kabuela bankambua"(bis)
Mu kanana, mu kanana" mua kabuela bankambua nunku netu buela momo"(bis)

hymns.title: BIPUPU BIKOLE BIDI KU MPALA KUETU

versions.title: BIPUPU BIKOLE BIDI KU MPALA KUETU

lines: Bipupu bikole bidi kumpala kuetu mateyi ne mapanga, ne bijika munyi bua meme kuya lelu mu njila wa lupandu. (bis)
Tatu Nzambi wanyi unsungile mpatula mu dijimba edi anu wewe tshieyemenu tshianyi mfula luse hozana. (bis)
Nzambi utshimuna bena lukuna banyi bapite ku tshilumbu, bafuishibua bundu palua dituku diadia ku mpala kua Kilisto.(bis)
Tatu Nzambi makenga kututonda tatu satana kututeya, bualu tuakupidia kunvua Di dieba tatu tufuile luse kashidi.(bis)
Nzambi utusungile ku mateyi lelu palua malu makole, tuvuluka Nzambi mu ntatu yetu yonso yeye ne atukuatshisha.(bis)

hymns.title: BOBUMUE BUKOLA BUETU, BOBUMUE LUPANDU LUETU BOBUMUE MIOYO YETU

versions.title: BOBUMUE BUKOLA BUETU, BOBUMUE LUPANDU LUETU BOBUMUE MIOYO YETU

lines: (tuimbayi bobumue) Bobumue bukola buetu, bobumue lupandu luetu bobumue mioyo yetu
(Tuetu tudi bietu) tudi bietu bu mikoku misokoka mu tshikumbi tshia nfumu wetu yesu(bis)
(Tuetu tudi bietu) tudi bietu ne bobumue ne muinda muteka ku mesa ne manjelu mu diulu(bis)
(Tuetu tuakapunga) tuakapunga diyi dimue dipungila mu lupanza lua mashi a musungidi(bis)
(Wewe wakapunga) wakapunga ne lupanza wamanya bienzedi biebe kabikuedi maluu(bis)

hymns.title: BUA GOGA NE MAGOGA BIDI BINKENGESHA

versions.title: BUA GOGA NE MAGOGA BIDI BINKENGESHA

lines: " Bua goga ne magoga bidi binkengesha " bua meme tshitangidi butumbi bua Nzambi wa muoyo" (bis)
" Makalenga ne matumbi bidi binkengesha"" bua meme tshitangidi butumbi bua Nzambi wa muoyo" (bis)
Commentaires (malu mabi 15)
" Ooo diba: diakumbanyi diba dia kumutendelela"( commentaires)

hymns.title: BUA KUBUELA YELUSHALEMA MUPIA MUPIA

versions.title: BUA KUBUELA YELUSHALEMA MUPIA MUPIA

lines: Bua kubuela Yelushalema mupia mupia, wambula weba mutshi mushamakana, mu ku tshiamakena ku njila wa mu diulu (bis)
"Thiendenda, tshiendenda tshia malunda mabi": meji mabi, masandi ne mpingu, kupaka kua manga, lukuna matandu, mkuau ne tshiji,
kutapuluka, mpata diyoyo, mutshaudi, bukuashiki bua maluvu, manayi ya bundu, kabena babuela. (bis)
Kakuena bualu budi busokoka, bua mpanga Nzambi wetu kusokolola muaba kayi uwaya kusokomena.(bis)
Pakubana tshikondo tshia mulayi, muana kayi muanetu uwalela mubidi anyi mamuma a nyuma tshitema. (bis)

hymns.title: BUA KUIKALA MUENA KILISTO ANU BIWASHIPA MUBIDI WEBE

versions.title: BUA KUIKALA MUENA KILISTO ANU BIWASHIPA MUBIDI WEBE

lines: Bua kuikala muna kilisto anu pawashipa mubidi webe ku milou ne nkuka ya panshi anu muakenza Polo. (bis)
mesu kaamono, matshi kaunvu malu, diulu kadinunkidi, bianza kabilengi, mukana kamuakulu. (bis)
Tuikalayi bena mudimu anu wakuamba kua lumu luimpe mu miaba yonso ituikala anu muakamba Yone. (bis)
Tukuama mamuma a nyuma: dinanga, disanka, lutulu, luse, ditalala, buimpe, bunanukidi, kudipuekesha mene, kudi kanda kakuena mukandu kumaluaa. (bis)

hymns.title: BUA KUJIKA SALA ABALAMA WA KASUMBA BUDIMI

versions.title: BUA KUJIKA SALA ABALAMA WA KASUMBA BUDIMI

lines: "Bua kujika Sala Abalahama; wa kasuma budimi", " budimi bua mu makapela, buvua ne lubuebue kupenga"
"muvua ne mitshi ya mamuma yeye wa kajika Sala".(bis)
Abalama mufue tumujika mua kajikabu Sala, mununu wetu,
"mu budimi bua mu makapela buvua ne lubuebue kupenga" mu budimi bua mu makapela mua kajikabo Sala."(bis)
Commentaires:
Abalahama mufue, tumijikayi mua kajikajikabo Sala...
Izaka mufue,...
Yakobo,...
"Tatu ngambilayi mushinga wa budima, ne busumbe", "budimi buanyi, budi tsenkela kama inayi uyipesha",
"budimi buanyi, bushala muaba wa kujika bafua ba mu tshota tshianyi" (bis)

hymns.title: BUA KULAMBULA BALA MILAMBU BAKAJITAPA MIELE NE TUELE

versions.title: BUA KULAMBULA BALA MILAMBU BAKAJITAPA MIELE NE TUELE

lines: Bua kulambula Bala milambu bakaditapa miela ne tuela, badisunsula mibidi yabo, babikila Bala kayi mua kuitaba. (bis)
mu meji enu nuakushipa muan’ enu, nusomba nende numuelela tshifufu, Yesu ku mutshi wakondopa mabedi, lukuka luenu ne lulela lufu. (bis)
Nakenzela diulu bibi kumpala kueba indi ne bubi, ndi muana weba mujimina, ndi kulomba unfue luse. (bis)
Tshiena mumanya dialua Yesu mu matutu kusungula. Luseka kayi lungikala lua lupela anyi lua mponda. (bis)

hymns.title: BUA KULEDIBUA KUA TSHIMISHONA MUNAZI

versions.title: BUA KULEDIBUA KUA TSHIMISHONA MUNAZI

lines: Bua kuledibua kua Shimishona munazi, muanjelo wakaya Manoa muna Solea " wakamuambila neuwalela munda muebe munazi " (bis)
Bana betu wayaya nuadimuka bua bunazi " bualu buebe bua munda kuambidi muna kuebe,",
"wamanya dihaya kadi luku hita ku mutu kuebe","wamanya Delila wakamanya bukola bua Shimishona" (bis)
Shimishona yeye mumane kuledibua wakaluangana nvita ne Pelesheta bena lukuna" bua kupikulaye tshisamba tshia Isalela mubupika" (bis)
Monayi lubombo lua meji a mubidi, Delila wakatungila Shimishona tshitungu tshikole" yeye kakamona mua kudi sombuela bananga" (bis)

hymns.title: BUA MIDIMU YONSO YA PA BULOBA IDI NE MIKENJI MUNDA MUAYI

versions.title: BUA MIDIMU YONSO YA PA BULOBA IDI NE MIKENJI MUNDA MUAYI

lines: Bua midimu yonso ya pa buloba;
(midimu) " idi ne mikenji yoyoyo munda muayi" (bis)
"Nunku Nzambi kupesha Mosa mikenji dikumi;
(Mosa mulunda wanyi) "yakue ungezela mudimu" (bis)
"Nzambi kuela diyi, mu mikenji yonso,
"dipatula yoyoyo mikenji ibidi";
"unanga Nzambi webe ne mutshima webe, unanga muntu nebe bu mudi mudisua". (bis) (X2)
Mamu Naomi wakamba, mamu Naomi wakamba, eyi Luta wanyi, kadi muntu mununu,
"yakue ku Nzubu ya baledi, Luta mulunda wanyi yakue ku nzubu ya baledi." (bis)
Commentaires
 Meme tshiena ne wa kukupiana, yakue ku nzubu ya baledi,…
 Meme tshiena ne tshia kukupesha, …
 Meme tshia ne wa kukusankisha, …
 Meme tsheha ne ba kukupiana,…
Ne Luta wakadila,ne Luta wakadila eyi mamu wanyi tshiena kushiya,(mua bana)
ne ndale yoyoyo konso ku walala, ne sombe yoyoyo konso ku wa somba,
ne vuale yoyoyo tshionso tshi wavuala, Nzambi neatupesha tshionso tshi wa lomba ,
Nzambi webe wa moyo Nzambi wanyi; natupesha yoyoyo lupandu lua moyo, natupesha yoyoyo lupandu lua katshidi(bis)

hymns.title: BUA MUDIMU WA NZAMBI WANYI WA KATSHIDI

versions.title: BUA MUDIMU WA NZAMBI WANYI WA KATSHIDI

lines: "Bua mudimu wa Nzambi wanyi wa katshidi, " tshiena mua kulengulula mudimu wa Nzambi"(bis)
"Udi musue kulonda bualu bua nyuma anyi, "indi musue kulonda tshiena ne mpata"(x2)
"Nakatangila kulu ekumona Nzambi", "muikale mu diulu mubandisha kulu".
Ne tshilulu tshia kumanda kua muzabi wandi, "tshia kuuja ntempelo tenta ne nyuma" (bis)
"Musela fima yonso wakadi ne mapuapua" "asabombo wa kutumbisha mukalenga" (bis)
"Bakadi babilanga batumbisha Nzambi", "wa tshijila wa tshijila wa tshijila Nzambi" wa tshijila wa tshijila wa tshijila Yesu; wa tshijila wa tshijila wa tshijila Nyuma. (bis)

hymns.title: BUALU BUA MILAMBU BUBANGILA KU TSHIBANGIDILU

versions.title: BUALU BUA MILAMBU BUBANGILA KU TSHIBANGIDILU

lines: Bualu bua milambu bubangila ku tshibangidilu Kana wa kalambula bintu bia kamena mu budimu Ebelo wa kalambula bana buta ba mikoko ne dianyi.(bis)
Lambulayi mikoko Ebelo ikale ne moyo lekelayi kulambula milambu yenu mu mubudi, tshiviudi tshia mubidi ke ditshipa Ebelo bonso buenu nudi kana.(bis)
Nzambi wa kakonka muanyi Ebelo udi penyi, Kana wa kamuandamuna , meme tshiena mulami wa muakunyianyi(bis)
Kana wa kanyema wa kasokoma ku mesu kua Yepowa, Kana wakalomba Yepowa muntu yonso wamusangana amushipa(bis)

hymns.title: BUALU BUA, MESU AMUKALENGE ADI KUDI BADI BAKANE NÉ MATSHIU ANDI ADI BUASHI KU MILOMBO YA BANTU BANDI.

versions.title: BUALU BUA, MESU AMUKALENGE ADI KUDI BADI BAKANE NÉ MATSHIU ANDI ADI BUASHI KU MILOMBO YA BANTU BANDI.

lines: Bualu bua, mesu amukalenge adi kudi Badi bakane, né matshi andi adi buashi ku milombo ya bantu bandi.(bis)
(bituikale), "bituikale, bajalame mu ditabuia dietu mene, netutambe maalu onso bu mua kenza nfumu wetu Yesu."(bis)
Ne nganyi wa nuenzele bibi bi nuikale nuenda ne lumu lua maalu mimpa a mukalenga, musungidi wa buloba ebu.
Kadi bi nuakengishibue bua bualu buanyi bimpe nusanke kanutshinyi kanutshinyi bua baka mukengesha.
Nenu njidila kilisto mu mitshima yenu kabidi bualu bua binuamujidile nenupeta tshidi nukeba.

hymns.title: BULELELA KAYI MPIDIEU BUTUDI NABU PA BOLOBA BUTUDI TUYISHA BANTU BA NZAMBI

versions.title: BULELELA KAYI MPIDIEU BUTUDI NABU PA BOLOBA BUTUDI TUYISHA BANTU BA NZAMBI

lines: Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi nabu pa buloba, butudi tuyisha bantu ba Nzambi• bulelela bua Nzambi anyi bua satana•.
Nzambi kuambi laye muntu wakatekaye mubudi mibi wadi a mutshi eu ufuafua bulelela,
satana pende kumuambila biwadia mutshi eu kuena ufua bulelela.
Bulelela kayi mpi ndi eu butudi tuyisha bantu ba Nzambi " Bulelela bua Nzambi anyi bua Satana".
bulelela, bulelela, bulelela, bulelela, bulelela bulelelao, bulelelaooo bulelela bua Nzambi,
" Nzambi mbulelela, yesu mbulelela, nyuma muimpe mbulelela" (bis)
Pakafuka Nzambi bintu bitudi nabi pa buloba wa kabifukila muntu bua asanke, " ne muntu wa Nzambi atumbe"
kadi lelu pa buloba kaba tshiена bayisha bantu Dî dia Nzambi wa muoyo bamanya bulelela,
bakadi anu babayisha bua bintu bia mubidi kamutshiyi bulelela.
Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi tuyisha bantu ba Nzambi " bulelela bua Nzambi anyi bua satana".
Bana betu bonso bananga badi basue kupeta muoyo, angatayi bonso mukanda nubale " ebelu chapita dikumi".
Kanuena muakulengela bua bintu binudi nufila bikala mindidimbi ya bintu bia mu diulu,
bua nyuma muimpe mumanyishi wa bualu bulelela, nyuma muimpe mbulelela.
Bulelela kayi mpindieu butudi tuyisha bantu ba Nzambi. " Bulelela bua Nzambi anyi buasat ana".

hymns.title: BULOBA BUA KAFUKA TATU NZAMBI KALE BUVUA NE MIDIOKO BUVUA NE BUITSHI

versions.title: BULOBA BUA KAFUKA TATU NZAMBI KALE BUVUA NE MIDIOKO BUVUA NE BUITSHI

lines: Buloba bua kafuka tatu Nzambi kale buvua ne midioko buvua ne buitshi, bantu bavua basanka ba tumbisha Yehowa, kabavua ne makenga kabavua ne lufu.(bis)
buloba yekelekele eyo" an yoyoyo buloba", pikala buloba ne makenga ne lufu,
"pikala buloba bushipa bantu budia Nzambi muea bantu udi mua kuenza tshinyi "(bis)
Diulu buloba telejayi matshi enu bimpe, Nzambi wa kanuteka bu bamanyi bende, wakateka lufu wakateka ne muoyo,
biwalonda lufu ne wikala ne lufu, biwalonda muoyo ne wikala ne muoyo.(bis)
Nzambi wakateka bambi bua kuyisha bantu, bantu bavua bakuna kambua bapaka manga, biwakala wewe unyanga bantu ushipa,
Nzambi muna bantu yeye ne asombuela buloba.(bis)

hymns.title: BULOBA TELEJA BIEBE, DIULU UNZULULA MASHI

versions.title: BULOBA TELEJA BIEBE, DIULU UNZULULA MASHI

lines: Buloba teleja bieba, (buloba teleja), diulu unzulula mashi unvua; meyi a Yepowa Nzambi, na kafuka bantu banyi, (bantu banyi)
" ku bateka pa buloba lelo kabena bamanya Nzambi "
Kadi tshianyi tshidi, (tshinyi tshia Nzambi), " kudi badi benza mibi, (bantu aba),
banyangi ba lumu luimpe luanyi meme, memeu ne bakengeshe bu mu nakenza Sodomo"
Nakatuma Yesu wanyi,(Yesu wanyi) bua abumusha mu bupika bua satana abaleja njila,
bantu bakabenga, (benga Yesu) bakapidia meyi andi, bakalondo njila ya patupu "
Bantu kabena bamaya (kabena bamanya) maalu anakenza kale kudi bantu bakapidia Nzambi,
mona tshikondo tshia Noa, (tshikondo tshia Noa), " nakatshipa bantu bonso ne nakosha Sodomo bua bubi "
Ndimanyisha bantu bandi (bantu bandi), balondi ba meyi yanyi meme ndi nabo too katshidi,
ndi mumanya maalu onso (maalu onso) adi kumpala kuenu meme ndi nenu too ne katshidi.

hymns.title: BUTUMBI EEEVOYOQO BUTUMBI

versions.title: BUTUMBI EEEVOYOQO BUTUMBI

lines: Butumbie eyoyoyo butumbi bua Yehowa masiya wanyi butumbi bua Yehowa
Bakuabu balenduka bua nkuasa mu butumbi...; bakuabu balenduka bua mfuanka...; bakuabo balenduka bua maluvu...; bakuabo balenduka bua buloji...;
Nzambi wa Petelo ne Yone ngua butumbi we... ; diba diakanyi bua kuimba bua butumbi we...; nyaya ku mai ne bansabula mu butumbi we...;
Nzambi wa banjelo ne bansantu ngua butumbi we.

hymns.title: CONELIYO BONSO BAKUNVUA BAKANGATA NYUMA KUATAYI MALALA KU BIANZA ELAYI BIANZA MULU PETELO MUSOMBA ULOTA.

versions.title: CONELIYO BONSO BAKUNVUA BAKANGATA NYUMA KUATAYI MALALA KU BIANZA ELAYI BIANZA MULU PETELO MUSOMBA ULOTA.

lines: Coneliyo bonso bakunvua bakangata nyuma kuatayi malala ku bianza elayi bianza mulu(bis)
Petelo musomba ulota; kumonayi tshilamba tshipueka, tshilamba tshifumina mu diulu, tshikuata ku nzemba inayi
kuledibua kua butumbi kua bena Coneliyo kanulumbuludi malu adi munda mua bakuabu (bis)
Nzambi wetu udi momumue kayi ne kansungasunga Nyuma udi mumumue kanutangidi bantu (bis)
Nyuma muimpe udi momumue nyuma wa bulelela tshia kalengeja mufuki kuambi ne tshia tshianana (bis)

hymns.title: DAVIDI WAKANYENGA MUSOKO YA YEBUSE

versions.title: DAVIDI WAKANYENGA MUSOKO YA YEBUSE

lines: "Davidi wakanyenga musoko wa Yebuse" "bualu Yebuse uvua uluisha bena Isalela" "bakauindika Yelushalema bupianyi bua Isalela"(bis)
"tukadi pabuipi ne kuya mu diulu" "bua kusomba mu musoko mutamba tshijila" "Yelushalema, Yelushalema puekaku meme mbuela" (bis)
"Ku Esete ku musoko, musoko wa Yelushalema" "kuvua bibi bisatu bia bana ba Isalela" "kuvua tshibi tshia Josefu, Dana ne Benyamina"(bis)
"Yona uvua mushisanga umona Yelushalema wa mu diulu" "upueka mutangila pa buloba mulongoluela bena Isalela"
"neubuela anyi ne ushale mu malu ebe a panshi, neubuela anyi ne ushale mu bintu biebe bia panshi" (bis)

hymns.title: DȊ DIA MUNGA MUNTU WAKELA LUBILA MÛ TSHIPELA.

versions.title: DȊ DIA MUNGA MUNTU WAKELA LUBILA MÛ TSHIPELA.

lines: Dî dia munga muntu wakela lubila mû tshipela ;(longolola)
" longololayi njila wa Yesu muana Nzambi wa bukola ".
" (longololayi bonso), longololayi njila wa Nfumu Yesu " ; batamija mikuna, landakaja mpongo yonso, seneja bizakalazakala, njila yonso alue mime. (bis)
Pakadi Yona ubatiza muana Nzambi wa bukole " diyi dia kafuma mu diulu eu muan’ anyi musuibue ".
Yona wakadi anu uvuala biseba bia Tumelo " ne mukaba mu tshimonu tshiandi uvua udia buishi ne mpasu "

hymns.title: DȊ DIA NZAMBI KALE DIA KADI NÉ BULELELA.

versions.title: DȊ DIA NZAMBI KALE DIA KADI NÉ BULELELA.

lines: Dî dia Nzambi kale dia kadi ne bulelela, dia kadi Nzambi mene bua luse ne buimpe " dia kadi ne Nzambi munda ne dia kenza malu makole"(bis)
Nzambi kufuka bantu ne Dî ne bulelela, kubelela mukenji munda mua budimi " kabakadi ne bulelela bua bakashipa mukenji" (bis)
Bua kujadika luse ne bulelela bia Nzambi, Yesu wa katumibua ne wakatufuila " luse luandi ne bulelela bia ka tutuadila muoyo" (bis)
Kadi tuetu ba Nzambi tudiela dikonka munda bua Dî dilelela didi kutudi anyi?" Bituikala ne bulelela ne tuleu bana ba Nzambi" (bis)

hymns.title: DȊ DIA NZAMBI YOYO DIODIO KI MUELE.

versions.title: DȊ DIA NZAMBI YOYO DIODIO KI MUELE.

lines: Dî dia Nzambi (ooo), diodio ke muela, wa kushipa nauvu, bantu badi bapanga" teleja Dî dia Nzambi diodio ki muela baditabuia ne batamba satana"(bis)
Tudi bamanya Yesu wa katufuila bua kutusungilaye ku malu mabi.(bis)
Ditabuia dietu dibakibue pa kilisto dibue dia kapidiabo kudi bibaki.(bis)

hymns.title: DȊ DIA YEPOWA DIAKALUA KUDI YONA NDA KU NINIWA.

versions.title: DȊ DIA YEPOWA DIAKALUA KUDI YONA NDA KU NINIWA.

lines: Dî dia Yehowa diakalua kudi Yona, ndaku ku niniwa bua bubi bua bantu bua kutamba ku mesu kuanyi" nganyi wanyi wabambila Yobua ku dilongolola" (bis)
Bakela meji, bakela nshobo" nshobo yakakuata Yona mu mayi yoyoyo nshobo yakakuata Yona" (bis)
Commentaires
Bakela meji, bakela nshobo" nshobo yakakuata muambi Nzambi yoyoyo nshobo yakakuata muambi" (bis)
Hashisha bakamukonka tukuenzela tshinyi?" bua mai manene atalala","nganyi wanyi wabambilayo bua kudilongolola" (bis)
Nungambule nu ngela mu mai, tshipupu tshilualua yoyoyo bua bualu buanyi" nganyi wanyi wa bambileyo bua kudi longolola" (bis)

hymns.title: DÎ DINUAKUNVUA DIDI NYUMA, BULELELA NE MOYO

versions.title: DÎ DINUAKUNVUA DIDI NYUMA, BULELELA NE MOYO

lines: Dî dinuakunvua didi nyuma, bulelela ne moya, didi ne mudimu muipe wa kuyisha bantu
" bua muntu wa Nzambi ikala mulongolola tshishiki ku midimu mimpe yonso idi isankisha Nzambi " (bis)
" (ndila), bua dina dianyifidunda anyiku mukanda wa moyo", "(kadi) Yepowa wanyifundedina dianyiku mukanda wa moyo" (bis)
Meme mubanda mu diulu bidi bimpe bienu, musambi nealue mufuma kudi tatu,
"neanubuluile maalu akadi masokoka nenumanya bunene bua tatu wanyi".(bis)
Tatu nakuenza mudimu unakaluila pa buloba, nakaleja dina dieba kudi bantu ba pa buloba,
ba kumanya bulele meme ndi mufuma kundi,ke meme eu tatu wanyi balambula kudi,
" ubavuiia bamue Nzambi wanyi, mu tudi neba bamue badi pa buloba bobo kaba tshiena ba pa buloba"(bis)

hymns.title: DȊ KE DIDI DILAMA NYUMA WA NZAMBI, BUA KUTAMBA MALU ONSO À PA BULOBA.

versions.title: DȊ KE DIDI DILAMA NYUMA WA NZAMBI, BUA KUTAMBA MALU ONSO À PA BULOBA.

lines: Di ke didi dilama nyuma wa Nzambi bua kutamba malu onso a pa buloba.
Biwakala wewe kuyi wenda ne Di neumbushibue munkatshi mua bana ba Nzambi,
" ne wikale ne muaba webe mumuaba wabafue, ne ushale mu bintu biebe biuvua nabi "
yoyoyo balunde: nyuma wa kilisto ke nsapi ya diulu, ne tusomba ne Yesu mu bukalenga bua diulu, ne tusombane masiya mu bukalenga bua diulu.(bis)

versions.title: KAPITA KA BENA MALUVU

lines: Kapita ka bena maluvu kakadi mu lukanu, ka kambila Josefu tshilota tshia mionji wa tumuma tua nvinyo tuakadi ne matamba asatu "ne lupanza lua Palo lua kadi mu tshianza tshiandi"

Kapita ka bena maluvu kakapwa Josefu moyo yeye kakamuvuluka too, nunku tuetu badi basungidibue tuteka mioyo yetu panshi

hymns.title: KUALUKILA KUANYI MEME KUDI KUSANKISHA NZAMBI

versions.title: KUALUKILA KUANYI MEME KUDI KUSANKISHA NZAMBI

lines: "Kualukila kuanyi (meme) kudi kusankisha Nzambi" Yepouva tatu indi muenzela diulu bibi, Yepouva tatu an an an,
indi muenza bibi ku mesu kueba, "kumbikidi muana mulela ndi muena mudimu weba." (bis)
Bilamba bianyi bia kupandika meme mutangalaji wa bintu bia tatu, bizubu bia mitshi biakudia bia nguluba , ke biakudia bianyi eyi "ngalukidi ngalukidi ngalukidi tatu wanyi"
Nejuke nenye kudi tatu; nendileeee nakujimina, nendileeee "ngalukidi ngalukidi ngalukidi Nzambi wanyi"
Muluatshikayi muana wanyi tshilamba tshimpe , numungeleleece kakanu ku munu numuluatshikeeee bisabata ku makasa , "netuibe netusanka bualu bua muana"
Commentaires

hymns.title: KUPITA KUA YEHOWA

versions.title: KUPITA KUA YEHOWA

lines: "Kupita kua Yehowa mu musoko wa bena Ejipitu", Yehowa mu kupita kuende wa kashipa bana buta,
"Muana wa muntu yonso, muana wa muena Ejipitu eyi bantu bakadila"(bis)
" kanuena mu Kanana, kanuena mu Kanana" "kadi "Mose" kakabuela mu Kanana"
"ne bantu bende bakabuela bonso mu Kanana"(bis)
"Bantu banana kuasa luendu batangila mu Kanana" mai kumpala baluishi panyima "bakadila muadi yoyoyo bantu bakadila"(bis)
"Mu njila muakadibo baya bantu bakajana Mose" "bivua bimpe tuetu kufuila mu Ejipitu " ndikenga dia mulau"(bis)

hymns.title: KUIKALA NE MINGA NZAMBI KUDI KUBI

versions.title: KUIKALA NE MINGA NZAMBI KUDI KUBI

lines: Kuikala ne minga Nzambi kudi kubi, kuyisongela mpingu kuyi tuila binu, kutela dina dia Yepowa mu kudi kubi mu malu adi kaayi ne dikuatshisha,
wewe nsongalume, wewe nsongalume uvuala kazaku wewa kupanga Nzambi,
wewe nsongakaji wewe nsongakaji uvuala mundula webe kupanga Nzambi.(bis)
mamu wakudia kukuta lelu wakupanga Nzambi wa moyo
Tatu wakudia wakukuta bieba wa kupanga Nzambi wa muoyo; wakuwala kadi kukuangatabu butuku ebu,
nganyi washala ne bintu biebe, yepowa Nzambi muaba wetu munene mu diulu mua Nzambi tudianu bu benyi panshi pa buloba
Utshidi wenda anu ntunku, wenda upenda Yehowa, kuena mu manya dituku dia lufu anyi disama.(bis)
bintu bieba Yehowa muaba wetu munene mu diulu mua mukalenga, tudi anu bubenyi panshi pa buloba.(bis)

hymns.title: KUJIDILA KUA BINGU YA YEPOWA NZAMBI DIYI DIAKULUA

versions.title: KUJIDILA KUA BINGU YA YEPOWA NZAMBI DIYI DIAKULUA

lines: Kujidila kua bingu ya Yepowa Nzambi diyi diakalua kudi Elemiya ne ;
" ambila bantu bonso ba mu Yudaya kabakuatshi mudimu dituku dia lumingu ".(bis)
kuata mudimu webe mu matuku asambombo, dia muanda muteketa ushina Yepowa ;
nansha Ngomba webe, nansha mpunda webe, nansha mupika webe, kabenji mudimu (bis)
Binuapidia bonso kunvuila Yepowa bua kutuala bujitu ku bibi bia musoko " nentemesha kapia mu Yelushalema bua koko ne kosha nzubu ya ba nfumu " (bis)
Binuananukila kunvuila Yepowa bakalenga ne ba minyampala benu " badi batshikama mu nkuasa ya Davidi ; nebendele pa mitu ya nyama ya tubalu " (bis)

hymns.title: KU KALE MU EDENA YEHOWA KAKUNA MITSHI

versions.title: KU KALE MU EDENA YEHOWA KAKUNA MITSHI

lines: " Ku kale mu Edena Yehowa kakuna mitshi ", " mutshi wa muoyo, mutshi wa kujingulula kua lungenyi ne wakudia"(bis)
tatu wanyi we: ne bakuela mulau, ne bakuela mulau, ne bakuela mulau.(bis)
Commentaires :
Bua kudisua kuebe
Bua kudiamba kuebe
Bua bijanu biebe
Tatu wanyi we …
"Pakalua kilisto wa kalua bua kutentula mitshi", "mutshi wa nfigi uvuu kauyi ne mamuma kilisto waka wela mulau"(bis)
"Muan’ etu ne mulunda tuikale ku mutshi wa muoyo", " mutshi wa nfigi uvua kauyi ne mamuma kilisto waka wela mulau"(bis)

hymns.title: KULEDIBUA KUA YONE MUANA WA ZEKAYI

versions.title: KULEDIBUA KUA YONE MUANA WA ZEKAYI

lines: Kuledibua kua Yone muana wa Zekayo, bena tshiota tshia kuandi bonso ne bena kuabo, bonso bakaya ba kimanyi na Elisabeta dina dia muana winyika Zekayo butatu wandi.(bis)
tshikondo tshia kukumbana muan’etu patuka mu bantu, mu bantu kamuena dinanga ne bakuidikijila ne bianza,
ne bakuluisha ne ku muoyo bendela neba mu lubombo.(bis)
Elisabeta wakabenga, wakabambila wanyi muana dina diandi didi anu Yone. bena tshiota bakambila Elisabeta dina dia Yone kaditu mu tshiota tshietu.(bis)
Bakakema bakaya benda bakatshila, benda bamba ne ku mikuna ya Yudaya, bualu Zekayo wakalomba mikanda yabo wakafunda dina dia muana didi anu Yone.(bis)

hymns.title: KULUMBULULA KUA MALU ADI MUNDA MUA BANTU KUDI KUBI

versions.title: KULUMBULULA KUA MALU ADI MUNDA MUA BANTU KUDI KUBI

lines: Kulumbulula kua malu adi munda mua bantu kudi kubi, kudi kubi, utshina Yehowa"shila Yehowa nkuasa wandi wa bilumbu"(bis)
udi umbushila tshinyi kasonsa kadi mu disu dia muanenu kuyi muanji kutangila mueba
"mukamba munena udimu kuyi muanji kuumbushwa(bis).
Kanupeshi mbuas tshintus tshia tshijilas nansha, kanuedi mabua panshi a mushinga mukole " padi nguluba yenda kayiadiatshi bikono"(bis)
Ni wewe udi nganyi bua kulumbuluisha mue na mudimu wa mu nzubu wa mukuenu" tuetu bonso ne tuimane ku tshilumbuluidi" (bis)

hymns.title: KUVUA MUNTU MUKUABU MOISE MUSUNGULA BUA KULOMBOLA BENA ISALELA MU NJILA

versions.title: KUVUA MUNTU MUKUABU MOISE MUSUNGULA BUA KULOMBOLA BENA ISALELA MU NJILA

lines: Kuvua muntu mukuabu Mose musungula bua kulombola bena Isalela mu njila,"
mukalenga waka mupa lungenyi wakenzenza malu mimpe wakasankisha balunda bakadiye nabo kale"(bis)
Isalela mu njila," mukalenga waka mupa lungenyi wakenzenza malu mimpe wakasankisha balunda bakadiye nabo kale"(bis)
tatu wa bana kuyi kule, Yehowa wanyi: " kabalu kukuata bana kudi nyama" (bis)
(Tatu wa bana)
Commentaires: Nyama ya lonji, bena buloji, bena biambamba, mikumbi, mibuabua …
Bilobo bia mukalenga Yesu tuyayi kumpala ne bana bakese" Nzambi ikala netu munkama ne mkama ya bidimu"(bis)

hymns.title: KUVUA MUNTU UMUKA MU YELUSHALEMA UYE MUTANGILE MÛ MUSOKO WA YELEKO.

versions.title: KUVUA MUNTU UMUKA MU YELUSHALEMA UYE MUTANGILE MÛ MUSOKO WA YELEKO.

lines: Kuvua muntu umbuka mu Yelushalema muye mutangila mu musoko wa Yeleko " wakasambakena ne banyengi ne bivi ku mututa bikole ku mushiya ne tshioyoyo"(bis)
(njila idi ngedela) Mu njila indi ngedela ya panshi pa buloba ne lungenji lua buntu tshiakapeta tshintu to,
ndi dila kudi tatu wanyi atuma nyuma muimpe bua yeye andombole bua meme tshinyanguki "(bis)
Ne muambi wa Nzambi wakalua wakapita ne muna Lewi se disua dia Yehowa " muna Samaleya wakalua wakadila, ku mulabaye manyi, ku mutekaye pampunda"(bis)
Ne Yesu wakamba dituku ne dileuwe dia tendelelabu tatu wanyi mu nyuma " ne wewe muan’etu ulamata ku Di,
edi Di dia nyuma mubidi tshiau lufu"(bis)

hymns.title: KUVUA MUNTU UPEUKA MU YELEKO WAKASAGANA BANYENGI

versions.title: KUVUA MUNTU UPEUKA MU YELEKO WAKASAGANA BANYENGI

lines: Kuvua muntu upeuka mu Yeleko wakasagana banyengi bena buivi bakamututa bamunyenga bintu yeye bakamushiya ne tshiyoyo (bis)
Muena Lewi pakaluaye wakasesuka, muambi wa Nzambi pakaluaye wakasesusa, muena Sameliya pakaluaye wakimana,
wamuteka tshianza pa moyo wakamunvua ne tshiyoyo " lusa lua mukuashe " (x4),
wakangata mayi ne nvinyo kusukula mputa yonso yakadi nayi muntu au waya nayi mu nzubu wa tshilala benyi " numulama bimpa too ne panalua "
Yesu kukonka mumanyi wa mikenji muan’abu ne muntu eu udi nganyi ? wakamuambila ne wakamufua luse wakamuambila ya bieba wenza nunku (bis)
Tuetu bonso tudidiela dikonka munda mu mudimu wa Nzambi utudi tuenza tudi bu muakuidi anyi bu muena Lewi bu muena Salamiliya uvua ne luse(bis)

hymns.title: KUPITA KUA YEPOWA MÛ MÛSOKU WA EJIPITU YEPOWA MÛ MUSUKO

versions.title: KUPITA KUA YEPOWA MÛ MÛSOKU WA EJIPITU YEPOWA MÛ MUSUKO

lines: Kuhita kua Yehowa mu musoko wa bena Ejipitu, Yehowa mukuhita kuende wa kashipa bana buta. Muana wa muntu yonso,
" muana wa muena Ejipitu eyi bantu bakadila " (bis)
" kanuena mu Kanana" " kadi Mose wa Nzambi kakabuela mu Kanana " " ne bantu benda bakabuela bonso mu Kanana "
Bantu ramana kuasa luendu batangila mu Kanana mai kumpala, baluishi panyima, "(bantu) bakadila muadi yoyoyo bantu bakadila"(bis)
" Mu njila muakadibo baya bantu bakajana Mose" "bivua bimpe tuetu kufuila mu Ejipitu"
"(edi) dikenga dia mulau (Nzambi wanyi) dikenqa dia mulau"(bis)

hymns.title: LUAYI BONSO BUENU, LUAYI BONSO NUMONE BU MUDI MUNYA MUTOKESHA

versions.title: LUAYI BONSO BUENU, LUAYI BONSO NUMONE BU MUDI MUNYA MUTOKESHA

lines: Luayi bonso buenu, luayi bonso numone bu mudi munya mutokesha. (bis)
Nzambi tatu ndiku: njila wa muoyo undeje, luaku unkuata ku tshianza tshianyi, mulunda wanyi kundekedi to.
Yesu muana ndiku: njila wa muoyo undeje, luaku unkuata ku tshianza tshianyi, mulunda wanyi kundekedi to.
Nyuma muimpe ndiku: njila wa muoyo undeje, luaku unkuata ku tshianza tshianyi, mulunda wanyi kundekedi to(bis)
Nganyi udi kayi, udi kayi mumone bu mudi munya mutokesha. (bis)
Disanka didiku, disanka didikoku bu mudi munya mutokesha. (bis)

hymns.title: LELELELE EU NZAMBI WA MAKANDA, LELELELE EU NZAMBI

versions.title: LELELELE EU NZAMBI WA MAKANDA, LELELELE EU NZAMBI

lines: Lelelele eu Nzambi wa makanda, Lelelele eu Nzambi Commentaires
- Eu Nzambi wa makanga Lelelele eu Nzambi wa makanda, Lelelele eu Nzambi
- Wa Kadima ne Milemba Lelelele eu Nzambi wa makanda, Lelelele eu Nzambi

hymns.title: LELU DITUKU DIA DISANKA

versions.title: LELU DITUKU DIA DISANKA

lines: Lelu dituku dia disanka diakanyi mulyai wa Nzambi " Nzambi mulyai udi Nyuma muimpe wakatulaya tatu Nzambi" (bis)
kadi tutuayi tshanga ; tshangawetshangawetshangawetshangawetshangawetshangaweti (bis)
Bana baluma ne bakaji songalume ne bakulumpe " Nzambi watuikijidi nyuma bu muakamba Yoela kale "(bis)
Mulayi wa bualu ebu udi kudi bana betu ne bonso " badi kule nebabikile mukalenga Nzambi kudiye "(bis)

hymns.title: LUAYI BONSO TUBANDE KU MUKUNA WA MUKALENGA TUYE KU MUSOKO MUIMPE

versions.title: LUAYI BONSO TUBANDE KU MUKUNA WA MUKALENGA TUYE KU MUSOKO MUIMPE

lines: Luayi bonso tubande ku mukuna wa mukalenga tuye ku musoko muimpe,
" mudi kamuyi dijinga ne diba, ngondo nansha mitoto mu butumbi bua Nzambi wa moyo ".(bis)
Yelushalema wa mu diulu sanka, " batumibue mbabu balue " bua kukuuja anu wewe musoko wa tshiendelela.(bis)
Shiyayi madimi yenu, nushiya ne nzubu yenu " mukalenga nanupeshe binga bintu kunyaya"(bis)
Ndekelu wa mudimu se difutu dia kusomba mu nkuasa " (wewe) ulubuluisha bisambi bia Isalela." (bis)

hymns.title: LUAYI TUIMBAYI NE DISANKA NJILA WA KUNZULUKA

versions.title: LUAYI TUIMBAYI NE DISANKA NJILA WA KUNZULUKA

lines: Luayi tuimbayi ne disanka njila wa kunzuluka, wakadi mujimina Nzambi lua utuenzeja. (bis)
Tuasakidila, tuasakidila Nzambi, tuasakidila Yehowa wa katutumina muana wandi bua kusungila bantu.
Satana kena musue lumu luimpe lua Nzambi, udi netu lukuna musue kulujimija. (bis)
Makenga adi mangi, bilumbu bidi bia bungi Nzambi lua utuenzeja mu malu mabi etu. (bis)

hymns.title: MALU AKENZA YEZU, PAKABIKAYI KU LUFU WAKAMUENEKA NÉ MOYO, MATUKU MAKUMI ANAYI

versions.title: MALU AKENZA YEZU, PAKABIKAYI KU LUFU WAKAMUENEKA NÉ MOYO, MATUKU MAKUMI ANAYI

lines: Malu akenza Yesu pakabikaye ku lufu wa kamueneka ne moyo matuku makumi anai "wamba malu a bukalenga; a bukalenga bua Nzambi"(bis)
Nuenu nenuangata bukole pa nupuekela nyuma muimpe pa mbidi penu; ne nuikale ba manyi banyi mu Yelushalema,
ne nuikale bamanyi banyi mu Yudaya yonso; mu Samalea ne kunfudilu kua buloba;"tudi dibindile nyuma muimpe, nyuma mulayi wa mukalenga"(bis)
Pa kadasingsiheye nabo wakabambila bikole kanumbuki mu Yelushalema nuindile mulayi wa tatu " mulayi wa tatu ulualua nyuma wa kudi Nzambi"(bis)
Bulelela Yone wa kabatiza ne mai, matuku ki mashala male anua batijibua bonso anua batijibua bonso buenu mu nyuma muimpe "(bis)

hymns.title: MALU A MUBIDI NÉ À NYUMA ADI MIMANYINANGANE BU MVITA.

versions.title: MALU A MUBIDI NÉ À NYUMA ADI MIMANYINANGANE BU MVITA.

lines: Malua mubidi ne a nyuma "adi mimanyinangana bu mwita"(bis)
" usungule, usungule, sungula weba njila", "sungula weba njila wa wewe kuya"(bis)
Bualu bua mubidi budi bukole " munanga makenga mubenga masanka "(bis)
Mvita ya bualu ebu idi mikole" ke nya munyinyi ne mashi bia mubidi wetu","nya makokeshi ne makelenga bia panshi pa buloba"(bis)

hymns.title: MALU À MUBIDI ADI MIMANYINANGANE NÉ MALU À NYUMA, BUA TUÉTU KATUMONU MUA KUENZA MALU ADI NZAMBI MUANYISHE.

versions.title: MALU À MUBIDI ADI MIMANYINANGANE NÉ MALU À NYUMA, BUA TUÉTU KATUMONU MUA KUENZA MALU ADI NZAMBI MUANYISHE.

lines: Malu a mubidi adi mimanyinangana ne malu a nyuma bua tuetu katumonumua kuenza malu adi Nzambi muanyisha.(bis)
" nganyi wangambidila Yesu alue bua ku tukuatshisha", "Yesu neatuma nyuma muimpe alue bua ku tukuatshisha"(bis)
Buloba budi neta ne mpukampuka mibi ya malu a panshi bua tuetu katumonu mua kuenza malu adi Nzambi muanyisha.(bis)
Lelu tudi tulomba muenezji wa malu atupa bukole bua tuetu kumona mua kuenza malu adi Nzambi muanyisha.(bis)

hymns.title: MALU ONSO À PA BULOB’EBU MAKENGESHIBUE NÉ BILUMBU BIA.

versions.title: MALU ONSO À PA BULOB’EBU MAKENGESHIBUE NÉ BILUMBU BIA.

lines: Malu onso aaa pa buloba ebu makengeshibue ne bilumbu bia " kuntonda tshiena ndia, tshiena nua to, muoyo munda we wa nyingaladi ".
Eyi dikenqa we moyo wa nyingaladi, bu meme mumanya tshiwa nansha kuledibua to,
nakadi kufuila munda mua mamu, bua tshimono ntatu ya pa buloba. (bis)
Dtuku dina kaledibua adi baledi banyi ne bantu bakuabo " bakasanka ne, bakanua mala lelu wa ndaya bakabungama ".
Ndi ngela mulau bua dituku adi dina kaledibua munda mua mamu, ne mabelaaa mamu wanyi akadiku anu bua meme kuamua " midima ibuikila buloba bua dituku adi dina kaledibua ".

hymns.title: MALU ONSO ANAKAMONA A PANSHI PA BULOBA

versions.title: MALU ONSO ANAKAMONA A PANSHI PA BULOBA

lines: Malu onso anakamona a panshi pa buloba " adi ne tshiji kudi Nzambi bualu nakaalonda"(bis)
Mungambidi mena udi kuepi? Mudimuishi mena udi kuepi? Muyishi mena udi kuepi?
"Ngajiminyi mu tshiota meme ku buela mu bantu, ngajiminyi mu balunda ne mu bena mukalenga"(bis)
Wanyi muyishi kilisto yeya ke njila wanyi " munya wa badi mu midima mupikudi wa bisamba"(bis)
Nzambi jadika lueba luse unfukila diulu ne buloba" mudi muana wa Nzambi musombe banjelo mulu ba muimbila"(bis)

hymns.title: MASANKA À TUDI NAU PANU PANSHI PA BULOBA, NÉ MEJI MABI À TUDI TUELA BUA KUENZELA BAKUABU, BIDI BININGALAJA NZAMBI MUFUKI WETU.

versions.title: MASANKA À TUDI NAU PANU PANSHI PA BULOBA, NÉ MEJI MABI À TUDI TUELA BUA KUENZELA BAKUABU, BIDI BININGALAJA NZAMBI MUFUKI WETU.

lines: Masanka à tudi nau panu panshi pa buloba, né meji mabi à tudi tuela bua kuenzela bakuetu, " bidi binyingalaja Nzambi mufuki wetu ". (bis)
nunku bena Nzambi tulekela bienzedi ebi, tudilombola mu njila muimpe bua katulu kudijimija,
mudimu utudi tukuata nenu eu udi wa kuenza ne meji, wakusungila mioyo ne bua kubuela mu diulu, tumbisha mukalenga upeta difutu,
" kakuena mutu wamena boua pa mikolo yandi to " (bis)
Makenga atudi tupeta panu panshi pa buloba, ne bidilu bionso bitudi nabi ebi dinda ne dilolo ; " bidi bienza bu manyoka a malu mabi etu "(bis)

hymns.title: MEME NAKAKENGA PANSHI PA BULOBA

versions.title: MEME NAKAKENGA PANSHI PA BULOBA

lines: Meme nakenga panshi pa buloba tshia kumona njila , "Nzambi wa lusa we wakatuma muana wandi kutukusungila"(bis)
we idi nganyi ne meme ndi nganyi, "patuaditeka pa muaba wa Nzambi tulumbuishe basungula banyi"
patuaditeka pa muaba wa Nzambi tulubuluisha bedibue manyi (bis)
Yesu wakamba ndi mohoji munene, tatu mulami wau bayidi se matamba "ditamba dia tapuluka kudi meme nedioshibue mu kapia "(bis)
Yesu wakamba meme ndi njila bua kuya kua tatu anu mupitshila kudi meme dianbedi , balunda banyi "tulondayi Yesu tetu tupeta moyo "(bis)

hymns.title: MEME NDI BUDIMI, MEME NDI BUDIMI NZAMBI TATU UKAYE BUDIMI BUA MUBI KOLODI TSHIANZA.

versions.title: MEME NDI BUDIMI, MEME NDI BUDIMI NZAMBI TATU UKAYE BUDIMI BUA MUBI KOLODI TSHIANZA.

lines: Meme ndi budimi, meme ndi budimi Nzambi tatu " ukaye budimi bua mubi kolodi tshianza "(bis)
Meme ndi budimi, Yesu muana meme ndi budimi "ukaye budimi bua mubi kolodi tshianza "(bis)
Meme ndi budimi Nyuma muimpe meme ndi budimi "ukaye budimi bua mubi kolodi tshianza "(bis)

hymns.title: MIOYO YENU, MIOYO YENU, MIOYO YENU BALUNDA BA MUKALENGA NUENU BENYI BA DI DIA NZAMBI ANGATAYI MIOYO.

versions.title: MIOYO YENU, MIOYO YENU, MIOYO YENU BALUNDA BA MUKALENGA NUENU BENYI BA DI DIA NZAMBI ANGATAYI MIOYO.

lines: Mioyo yenu(x3) balunda ba mukelenga nuenu benyi ba di dia Nzambi angatayi mioyo, mioyo ya disanka
" Yepowa Nzambi ne anulame mu bienzedi bienu, ne ikale nenu mu kuenda, mu kuenza nansha mu kuamba yeye udi dibue "
Kadi wewe tatu wewe mamu biwapidia diyi Nzambi kadi wewe newedibue mu ngena wa katshidi
Tuetu bonso(x3) tu anu bu benyi tubukayi mu malu ne malunda bia panshi pa buloba, ne tupete moyo
" Yesu wa Nzambi ne atupikule mu makenga onso, ne ikale netu mu kuenda, mu kuenza nansha mu kuamba, katumupidito "

hymns.title: MIOYO YENU MIOYO YENU TUDI TUNUELA MIOYO NE DISANKA

versions.title: MIOYO YENU MIOYO YENU TUDI TUNUELA MIOYO NE DISANKA

lines: Mioyo yenu, mioyo yenu tudi tunuela mioyo ne disanka.(bis)
Tunangangana, tumona Yehowa; tukuatangana tuimane tshishiki, mioyo yenu, mioyo yenu, tudi tunuela mioyo ne disanka.(bis)
Ne disanka, ne disanka, ne tumonangane ku musoko wa tshijila.(bis)
Bitualonda, bitualonda mukenji wa dinanga wa mu Yesu muana.(bis)
Tukitamba, tukitamba dinanga dia bushuwa dia mu Yesu muana.(bis)
Tatu Nzambi, tatu Nzambi bua luse luebe tuakumonangana lelu.(bis)

hymns.title: MISOKO TSHITEMA IDI ILUISHA ISALELA IDIANU MÛ WEWE MUNTU WA NZAMBI.

versions.title: MISOKO TSHITEMA IDI ILUISHA ISALELA IDIANU MÛ WEWE MUNTU WA NZAMBI.

lines: Misoko tshitema idi iliusha Isalela" idi anu mu wewe muntu wa Nzambi", " udikonke udikonke mu mutshima weba"(bis)
" Kuena musua kulekela Amola(…) mulunda wanyi,", wewe ne ushale tshibandidi tshia bantu(bis).
Midimu ibidi idi ipangisha muntu" bua kubuela mu bukalenga bua Nzambi" ulekela kuenza bubi ne upeta muoyo"(bis)
Wewe muanetu wanyi munanga udikonke mu mutshima webe" kuikadi wewe Heloda munkatshi mua bana ba Nzambi,",luaku kudi Yesu ne upeta muoyo"(bis)

hymns.title: MONA BANTU BA MATUKU À À BUA MIBI NÉ MIKENJI KABENA BA BUELA MÛ DIULU.

versions.title: MONA BANTU BA MATUKU À À BUA MIBI NÉ MIKENJI KABENA BA BUELA MÛ DIULU.

lines: " Mona bantu ba matuku à à bua mibi né mikenji kabena ba buela mû diulu. "
" badi basungula ba nyuma wa nyuma wa moyo bobo badi babuela babenga mubidi "
Kadi tuimbayi :
 " tshianga eyo tshianga alleluya "
