versions.title: PAKADI BENA ISALELA BAMANA KUENDA LUENDU LULE BAKATOMBOLA NZAMBI

lines: Pakadi bena Isalela bamana kuenda luendu lule bakatombokela Nzambi bakajinga Ejipitu, " bakajinga ayi, bakajinga comcombre ne melona ne munyinyi wa mu mayi, bonso bakatombokela Yepowa "
Malu akadi a mutshinga muimpe kundi, bintu biakadi bia mutshinga mukole kundi " bua meme njimijile (yoyoyo) njimijile bua kupeta Kilisto",
Kilisto udi nenda, moyo udi nau "nyau mbala bintu bionso ubimansha ku diala"

Pakamana bena Isalela kutshibula musoko wa Yeleko ne lumbu " bakatombokela Nzambi bakajinga kuasulula musoko ne lumbu " " tshiena ngasulula musoko wanyi wa buta neafue, tshiena kujadikila bibi wanyi wa mukala neafue Yepowa udi ne bukole "
" Neutambe, neutambe ku tshinyi bua meme kupingana kabidi mu bitapikidi bu nguluba mumana kowa mayi "
mpunda invua nayi , masandi meme muenda , mupongu uvua nau, buloji meme mulowa , manga meme nau, majibu meme muenza ; "nyau mbala bintu bionso ubimansha ku diala"

hymns.title: PAKADI YEZU UDIA NÉ BAYIDI BANDI KABAYI BOWA MAYI BONSO KU BIANZA BIABO.

versions.title: PAKADI YEZU UDIA NÉ BAYIDI BANDI KABAYI BOWA MAYI BONSO KU BIANZA BIABO.

lines: Pakadi Yesu udia ne bayidi bandi "kabayi bowa mayi bonso ku bianza biabo" bualu ebu bakakemesha bafalesa bonso ne banfudi(bis)
Mufalesa se wewe, mufundi se wewe, " nsukola lungenyi ne meji bianza ne bitoka " (bis)
Nfumu Yesu wakabandamuna nenu bamanyi ba mikenji lelu mulau ulualua kunudi ku dituku dionso, " bualu nuakuvuwa mpanza pa mbelu munda mubola " (bis)
Yesu udi mpokolo wa mayi ya kowa, " bufalesa bua kujika meme nakulowa muyidi wa Yesu " (bis)

hymns.title: PAKADI YEZU WENDAKANA MÛ NJILA WA KAMONA MUTSHI MUIMPA WA MAMUMA.

versions.title: PAKADI YEZU WENDAKANA MÛ NJILA WA KAMONA MUTSHI MUIMPA WA MAMUMA.

lines: Pakadi Yesu wendakana mu njila wakamona mutshi muimpe wa mamuma. Pakafikaye bua kupola mamuma kakasangana dimuma nansha dimue.(bis)
Tangilaye bienzedi bienu binudi nuezela Nzambi, dimukaye kaba nubandi ne malu mabi " Yehowa Nzambi unfuile luse"(bis)
Nuenu bana ba Yehowa nuadimuka tshisuyi tshiela kuinshi kua mutshi onso, mutshi onso udi kauyi mamuma ne bautapa ne ba wela mukapia.(bis)
Lelu tuetu bonso mu nzubu wa Nzambi ba tatu, ba mamu ne balunda betu, nansha tuetu bikala bena kilisto tukuama mamuma adi makumbana.(bis)

hymns.title: PAKADI YONA UBATIZA BANTU BONSO MU YADENE YESU WA NZAMBI WAKAYA BUA YONA AMUBATIZA

versions.title: PAKADI YONA UBATIZA BANTU BONSO MU YADENE YESU WA NZAMBI WAKAYA BUA YONA AMUBATIZA

lines: Pakadi Yone ubatiza bantu bonso mu Yadena" muana wa Nzambi wakalua bua Yone amubatiza, Yesu wa Nzambi wakalua bua Yone amubatiza (bis)
monayi: Yone kuamba kubengaye bua kubatiza muana wa Nzambi, Yesu ku muambila ne "Yone wetu tuenza nunku bua kuakaja buimpe bonso",
" diulu ku bululuka nyuma kupuekelaye muana wa Nzambi, Dȋ kufuma mu diulu ‘"muan’anyi udi usankisha’’ (bis)
Yesu udi umbukila mu musoko wangalela" kubuela mu lungenyi luebe diulu ku bululuka"(bis)

hymns.title: PAKAFIKA TSHIKONDO TSHIA KASUNGULA YEPOWA BUA KUYA NE ELIYA

versions.title: PAKAFIKA TSHIKONDO TSHIA KASUNGULA YEPOWA BUA KUYA NE ELIYA

lines: Pakafika tshikondo tshia kasungula Yepowa bua kuya ne Eliya, Eliya kuambila Elisha wewe ushale kunoko "Yepowa wakutuma ku Betele"
bu mudi Yepowa ne moyo, mushima webe ne moyo "Eliya tuyaya nebe; bakaya ne Elisha ku Betele"
Eliya kuambila Elisha ulombe tshiudi musue Elisha wa kalomba; bitupa bibidi bia nyuma "wakalomba bualu bukole"

pakamonaye Eliya uye mulu mu nvudeee, Elisha wakadila "eyi tatu wanyi " eyi tatu wanyi dikalu dia Izalela ne badi bende pa tubalu tuadi "Eliya wakabanda tshikowelu kushala, elayi meji bimpa bua tuetu kupiana"
Bua ditabuja dia Elisha kakapanga too kulonda Eliya Eliya kuambila Elisha wewe ushale kunoko "Yepowa wakutuma ku
Yeleko , bu mudi Yepowa ne moyo, mushima webe ne moyo "Eliya tuyaya nebe bakaya ne Elisha ku Yeleko"

Bana betu luayi tulondayi Dȋ dia nyuma tuetu tupeta moyo bumuakenze Elisha yeye kulonda Eliya bakasabuka Yadena, Eliya Dȋ dia nyuma divua Elisha ulonda " Elisha kuangata tshikowelu bukole bua nyuma wa Eliya"

hymns.title: PAKAJIKIJA NZAMBI KUFUKA BINTU WAKELA MEJI BUA KUFUKA MUNTU.

versions.title: PAKAJIKIJA NZAMBI KUFUKA BINTU WAKELA MEJI BUA KUFUKA MUNTU.

lines: Pakajikija Nzambi kufuka bintu, wakela meji bua kufuka muntu ne tshinfuanyikiji tshia Nzambi tatu"mufuanangane ne Nzambi"
Nzambi kudifuka mu mubidi bu muntu, kuenzaye buloba kuelaye muhuya wa muoyo muntu kuimanaye papa ekutangilaye Nzambi,
kamanyi kua kufumaye ne tshivuaye wenza nansha, Nzambi kubikila muntu ne muntu ku muitabaye, " muntu kuenda tunku yeye kusankaye,
ne banjelo ba mu diulu bakasankila mu muntu, bakimba batumbisha Nzambi Yehowa mufuki wetu"
Bua kutulejaye bu muntu buandi wakamueneka kudi Moise, kutuma Yesu bu muntu nunku" mu mubidi wa bukoya "
Wananga muntu wakutangilaye, munanga Nzambi udiye kayi mutangila, bua Nzambi kena ne mubidi bu wa muntu, namumona diba kayi anu dia kunshikidilu.

hymns.title: PAKAKUATA NZAMBI MUDIMU WA KUFUKA NE KUENZA DIULU DIA KAFIKIBUA.

versions.title: PAKAKUATA NZAMBI MUDIMU WA KUFUKA NE KUENZA DIULU DIA KAFIKIBUA.

lines: Pakakuata Nzambi mudimu wa kufuka ne kuenza diulu dia kafikibua buloba bua kafukibua , "buloba kabuakadi ne tshintu anu mayi ke akadi pa buloba"(bis)
Nzambi wanyi "ne bafunde dina ku mukanda wa moyo" "bua bisonji ne kudila kabitshiena ne muaba" (bis)
Nzambi kololayi tshianza kumitsha mayi pa buloba "Buloba kutshala anu buloba midima yonso ya kajika" (bis)
Buloba wetu buloba wamanya kutshiadi anu buloba, (wewe) "uvuijibue mukuna wangata lupandu lua katshidi "(bis)

hymns.title: PAKAMONA POLO MATAPULUKA MUNKATSHI MUA BENA NZAMBI WABO POLO WA KAMBA.

versions.title: PAKAMONA POLO MATAPULUKA MUNKATSHI MUA BENA NZAMBI WABO POLO WA KAMBA.

lines: Pakamona Paulo matahuluka munkatshi mua bena Nzambi wabo Paulo wakamba""lekela ku sungululangana tshidi tshitumbusha mu njila muakana wa Nzambi"
Ekelezia ki nguebe, Ekelezia ki nguanyi, Ekelezia ngua Nzambi tatu " musumba, musumba ku mashi a Yesu";
lekela, lekela, kudienzela malu, lekela lekela, kudiambuila nkuasa.(bis)
Wewe mesu tshimona ya bende nganyi waya kamona yakuebe, nganyi wayamba";"ukinangana ne balunda bebe, tshinyi tshi wapeta mukuamba kuebe yeye wakamba".

hymns.title: PAKAPOLA YEZU MOYO KU MUTSHI MUTSHIAMAKANA.

versions.title: PAKAPOLA YEZU MOYO KU MUTSHI MUTSHIAMAKANA.

lines: Pakapola Yesu muoyo ku mutshi mutshiamakana, muyidi wa Yesu mukuabu wa mu musokoko" Yosefu wa mu alimatayo wakalomba Pilato bua angata tshitalu tshia Yesu ajike".
" Nfumu Yesu Dȋ dia Nzambi ditudi nadi difua mu ngenyi bajika mu muoyo mukana badiamba"
kua kashipelabo Yesu muaba wa mitshi ya mamuma, mumuaba au muakadi lukita lupialupia
"muakadi tshitalu tshikuabo katshiyi tshijikibuamu too bakajika amu Yesu muana wa Nzambi".
Yesu udi ujikibua mu lukita lupialupia mudi kamuyi mu bole muntu nansha tshintu" muanetu utangila mu lukita luebe bimpe ndulengeja pa mutu munda ludi lubole".

hymns.title: PAKITABUJA BENA SAMALEYA KUNVUA DȊ DIA NZAMBI BAKA BATUMINA BA POSTOLO PETELO NE YONA

versions.title: PAKITABUJA BENA SAMALEYA KUNVUA DȊ DIA NZAMBI BAKA BATUMINA BA POSTOLO PETELO NE YONA

lines: Pakitabuja bena samaleya kunvua Dȋ dia Nzambi wabo baka batumina ba Postolo Petelo ne Yone, babalombela Nzambi tatu bua kuangata kua nyuma muimpe, bakadi babatijibua mu dina dia Yesu.(bis)
Argent yeba ufua nayi, or yeba ufua nayi bua kuangata kua nyuma muimpe kakuena mu bintu nansha.(bis)
Wewe muan’etu mu Yesu kudimuna mutshima webe ulekela kuenza malu mabi ne umueneke kudi Yesu.(bis)
Utshidi mu nyonga ngandu wa bululu ne muluka nul uamal umabi apanshi, bakul ombel awewaNzambi.(bis)

hymns.title: PAKUNVUA BENA NINIWA BUA DIBUTUKA DIABO BONSO BAKADILA MUADI.

versions.title: PAKUNVUA BENA NINIWA BUA DIBUTUKA DIABO BONSO BAKADILA MUADI.

lines: Pakunvua bena Niniwa bua dibutuka diabo bonso bakadila muadi kubangila ku nfumu wabo ne muntu yonso" bakaji ne baluma, bana ne bimuna biabo"(bis)
Yepowa:
 Nzambi angata buloji buanyi meme ngikala ne muoyo
 Nzambi angata manga anyi meme ngikala ne muoyo
 Nzambi angata Majitu anyi meme ngikala ne muoyo
 "Nzambi wa kabunvuila bonso bakapeta muoyo"(bis)
Bakaluata bilulu bikayabala, bakasomba mu butu bajila biakudia" bakadila bikole Nzambi wa kabunvuila"(bis)
Muena niniwa si wewe utshidi ne bijanu biebe, muena niniwa si wewe utshidi ne kabuabua kebe(15), muena niniwa si wewe utshidi ne nkuasa wa bukalenga,
utuluka pa mpunda bonso tumona mukalenga, utuluka pa mpunda bonso tupeta moyo"(bis)

hymns.title: PANDI NTANGILA MUDIMU EU WA KENZA NZAMBI NE BIANZA BIANGI MUINSHI MUA DIBA.

versions.title: PANDI NTANGILA MUDIMU EU WA KENZA NZAMBI NE BIANZA BIANGI MUINSHI MUA DIBA.

lines: Pandi ntangila, mudimueu wakenza Nzambi ne bianza biandi muinshi mua diba. " tshiena ne disanka mu malu onso a muoyo wanyi wapabuloba"(bis)
Nzambi wakafuka diulu ne buloba; misulu ya mai manene, mudimu wa bianza biebe " Nzambi wanyi anu wewe kakuena mukuabu"(bis)
Nzambi ungumbusha muba pabuloba bua tshimonyi dikenga dia kunshikidilu" wewe wakatuma muana umuepele bua yonso wa muitabuja kafu biandi"(bis)
Wewe mu ditshipa kudi Nzambi webe kujanguluki nansha bua kumana mulayi" yeye kena usanka bua bantu bapote, upingana kudiye ufuta tshiwakalaya"(bis)

hymns.title: PAWASHIPA MUANENU

versions.title: PAWASHIPA MUANENU

lines: Pawashipa muanenu, biwamuelela maluvu panshi, neupeta tshinyi mu bualu bu wa kuenza, wakuvudija mabanza ebe" ne mulau munene ne wikale kûdi"(bis)
bualu budi bu matshisha mashi a bantu panshi budi yoyoyo mukau, munda munda, difuilakana dia nfualanga ne disonguelangana,
dinyanga lumu lua muntu mukuabo"wa kushipa muoyo wandi tshiendelela"(bis)
Pawashipa muanenu bua mukau udi munda muebe ne upeta tshinyi ku bintu bienda bionso? Wakuvudija mabanza ebe" anu Nzambi nkayandi neakulumbuluishe"(bis)
Wewe muena tshitungu udi mufuana biebe Yudasa, wakapeta tshinyi pakashipaye Yesu? Wakavudija mabanza ende "neufue biebe lufu lufuana lua Yudasa"(bis)

hymns.title: PELABO MPUNGI WA NZAMBI

versions.title: PELABO MPUNGI WA NZAMBI

lines: Pelabu mpungi wa Nzambi pajika malu onso paya bantu bantu ba Nzambi pepi nandi, nebasangakana nandi kulu nebasanka be nebashale kudi Yesu katshidi
"Pelabo mpungi wa Nzambi" "pelabo" mpungi wa Nzambi, mema nenya kudi Yesu katshidi.
Tuenze pa buloba malu adi manyisha Nzambi, tuenda bietu mu njila wandi bimpa, nunku pamuenekayi dituku dia ku tshikidilu tuetu ne tupande lufu katshidi
Pamona bantu ba satana ne Yesu ulualua ne manjelo bandi dituku diadia mishima yabo neyipandike nebandile muadi bakapidia Yesu matuko onso.

hymns.title: PETELO KUAMBILA YESU, MUKALENGA WANYI WE

versions.title: PETELO KUAMBILA YESU, MUKALENGA WANYI WE

lines: Petelo kuambilayi Yesu; mukalenga wanyi we meme ndi ne dikima dia kufua nebe "netuya nebe ne mu nzubu wa lukanu" (bis)
(Yoyoyo tshitala); tshitala ka tshianji kusama, wewe ne uvila Yesu "mu kuenza kua malu a bundu mukalenga nakuvile" (bis)
Mukaji mueji wa mudimu wakamujadika, muntu eu wakadi ne Yesu wa Nzambi "Petelo wakadishipa ne tshiena mumanya" (bis)
Pakadi bantu bamunguile nakamuambile ne , ne wewe udi anu bu muena Dȋ "tshiakuidi tshiebe tshidi tshikusokolola"(bis)

hymns.title: PETELO KAMBILA YESU, YESU WANYI MEME NETUFUA NEBE

versions.title: PETELO KAMBILA YESU, YESU WANYI MEME NETUFUA NEBE

lines: Petelo kambila Yesu muana Nzambi wewe netufua neba(bis)
Yesu wakamuambilaaa, wewe udi ushimaaa, pamba bitala kusama misangu isatu wewe neumpidie (bis)
Tulekela kuditshipa bana betu bikala kuenza kakuyiku(bis)
Tukela kuditshipa bulelela kudi kutufuitshisha(bis) \

hymns.title: POLO NÉ SILA BAKABALEJA KUDI NYUMA MUIMPA MÛ TSHIKENA KU MONA.

versions.title: POLO NÉ SILA BAKABALEJA KUDI NYUMA MUIMPA MÛ TSHIKENA KU MONA.

lines: Polo ne Sila bakabaleja kudi nyuma muimpe mu tshikena kumona bua kaya kuamba Dȋ dia Nzambi ku musoko eu wa ku Mekadoniya
biatupendabo bua dina dia Nzambi, biatusekabo bua bualu bua Yesu anyi biatutshiminyinabo mashimi abo bualu bua Yesu Kilisto katutekeshi
Bakabakuata, bakabatuta, kabakapisha ku tshilubuluidi, kubela mu nzubu wa lukanu kadi Nzambi wa misumba katu walala.
Bimbala Nzambi nzubu kukanka, minyololo ivua mibasuika kutuka mulami kusua kudishipaye Polo kumuambila tuetu bonso tudimu.
Bena kilisto katutekeshi biatutshiminyinabo mashimi bua Yesu, bana ba Nzambi katulekedi bua kutangalaja lumu luimpe bua Yesu.

hymns.title: POLO NE SILA BAKAYA

versions.title: POLO NE SILA BAKAYA

lines: Paulo ne Sila bakaya kuamba Dȋ dia Nzambi mu misoko yonso. Nambi wakabatuma, bakaya mu filipoyi bantu kabakitaba, baka bakuma mabue, baka bakengesha.(bis)
Bakakuma Polo ne mabue, bakamuela mu nzubu wa lukanu"bakambila mulami wakutshibi diyi ne udimuke wewe umulame bimpe.(bis)
Balunda banangibue katutshinyi makenga ne ntatu bia buloba; nansha bia tupendabo tuya muakuenza bietu bumuakenza Paulo.(bis)

hymns.title: SHAULA UDI NE DIKIMA DIA KUKENGESHA BENA KILISTO

versions.title: SHAULA UDI NE DIKIMA DIA KUKENGESHA BENA KILISTO

lines: Shaula uvua ne dikima bua kukengesha bena kilisto uvua ne lukunukunu lua kukuata ne kutshipa bana ba Nzambi "munya munene kumutekemena Shaula wakapona panshi"(bis)
unvua Shaula nakulua Polo ngalekedi kutshipa kua bantu, malu ngedi ku dyala, bualu nakupiana kilisto
"nyaya mu bisamba bia bende nyaya mu bisamba bia bende nyaya kuenzela Nzambi mudimu" (bis)
Pakaya Polo mukuamba kua lumu luimpe lua Nzambi, wakatuisha bena Yuda ubambila ne eu Kilisto;
kadi wewe munyagi wa bantu kuena na muaba mu diulu nansha, kadi wewe mutshipi wa bantu kuena ne moyo wa tshiendelela" (bis)
Polo udi lupanza lua kasungilabo kudi Nzambi bua kutuala dina diende kudi ba mu bisamba bia bende "kudi ba nfumu ba pa buloba ne kudi bana ba Isalele"(bis)

hymns.title: SIMONA WA BA YONA UDISHA MIKOKO YANYI

versions.title: SIMONA WA BA YONA UDISHA MIKOKO YANYI

lines: Simona wa ba Yona udisha mikoko yanyi mudimu munene udi mushila udisha mikoko "kanyinganyinga kakakuata Petelo bualu Masiya wa kamukoka misangu isatu"(bis)
lelu dituku dia pentecoste se tshiona tshia mu diulu bavua popamue bavua bonso ne dinanga bavua bakula mu miaku mikuabu bimba ne misambu bualu diba ditshivua pa tshitemba ke banua maluvu (bis)
Petelo ne Yona bakenza mudimu wabu bakaya kafila moyi masaka mu Samaliya "bakadi baya batuma kudi nyuma ba Positolo alluluia nu Yelushalema"(bis)
Petelo wakaya kubuela mu Galisaliyo mukenza mudimu mu tshilamba "ushipa udia nyama nyoka ne nyunyi wa kajikijika mudimu wa nyuma mua Coneliyo"(bis)

hymns.title: TSHIBANGIDILU TSHIA LUMU LUIMPE

versions.title: TSHIBANGIDILU TSHIA LUMU LUIMPE

lines: Tshibangidilu tshia lumu luimpe lua Yesu Kilisto; Yesu muana wa Nzambi, bakasungula bayidi bandi dikumi ne babidi "(muana wa Nzambi) wakenza mudimu mukole bua mioyo ya bantu" (bis)
Muanetu wamanya; Nzambi, Nzambi tatu udi munda muetu
Muanetu wamanya; Yesu, Yesu muana udi munda muetu
Muanetu wamanya; Nyuma, Nyuma muimpe udi munda muetu (bis)
"Yudasa kutungila Yesu kilisto muana Nzambi"; bakamupopela yoyoyo milonda mu bianza ne minga mu makasa Yesu kayi ne bualu,
bakamutua difuma luanga ne mayi biapatuki "bua kusungila bantu bonso ba panshi pa buloba"(bis)
"Pilato kubatekelaye Yesu ne Balaba" bena Yuda bonso bakasungula Balaba; Balaba mushipi wa bantu, bakasungula Balaba,
Balaba ikala ne moyo, bakambila Pilato Yesu watufuidi, "mashi a Yesu ikala pa nbidi petu ne bana betu" (bis)

hymns.title: TSHIAKADI MUMANYA MALU ALUALUA KUNDI MAKENGA MAKOLE AKULUA NTSHIYI MUMANYA ANU NZAMBI.

versions.title: TSHIAKADI MUMANYA MALU ALUALUA KUNDI MAKENGA MAKOLE AKULUA NTSHIYI MUMANYA ANU NZAMBI.

lines: Tshiakadi mumanya malu alualua kundi makenga makole akulua ntshiyi mumanya anu Nzambi utudi tuimbila buila buasha udi mumanya "bua kujikija anyi anu bua luse"(bis)
(mema tshiena) banda tshiena banda muntu nansha muntu nansha yeye muikala ku buaklu tshiena kengesha moyo wanyi munda
Nzambi wa moyo ungunvuile pandikulomba luse Tatu wa bana ungunvuile tshilu muntu mubi. (bis)
Tshiena ne disanka bua malu adimona "ukolesha mushima wanyi yepowa wa luse"(bis)
Tudi ku tshilumbu bualu tuabengi Nzambi katubengi Nzambi wa moyo anu bualu bua makenga adi kutudi "ne kulonda minga njila, njila ya lufu"(bis)

hymns.title: TSHIA MULAYI

versions.title: TSHIA MULAYI

lines: Nzambi wakandaya tshia mulayi tshiandi, Kilisto Yesu udi mulayi wandi, mulela wa mu diulu tshia mulayi tshiandi tshia mu diulu tshidi moyo wa tshiendela(bis)
Nenu bena mupongu nuditshipa bua mupongu, nenu bena masenda, nuditshipa bua masenda, nuenu bena buloji nuditshipa bua buloji, nulela bana nudie;
bakuabu nuandamuna bilengulengu, bakuaba nuandamuna bu nguluba , nfalanga mina nupongola, nuditsha bana benu banudi balela mu tshianda, nupangila tshiakulaya Nzambi (bis)
Muntu neafile tshiakalayayi Nzambi , Nzambi kena disanka ne bapote, moyo wanyi wa pa buloba, bintu bionso bidi munda muanyi ne mbifila bu tshia mulayi(bis)
Bulela ngaditshipi ndualua kudi musangu eu bianza bianyi biela mulu, ngalekedi bintu bianyi bionso ngalekedi,ngalekedi, ngalekedi.(bis)

hymns.title: TSHIENA NTANGILA MAPANGA A BA TATU BANYI

versions.title: TSHIENA NTANGILA MAPANGA A BA TATU BANYI

lines: tshiena ntangila mapanga a bana betu aba, Nzambi unfuile luse (bis)
(ndi muntu mudi) ndi muntu mubi bulelela ndi ntonda mibi yanyi kudi Nzambi unfuile luse (bis)
tshiena ntangila mapanga a ba tatu aba, Nzambi unfuile luse (bis)
tshiena ntangila mapanga a ba mamu aba, Nzambi unfuile luse(bis)
Ntshiena ntangila mapanga a bakuaba aba (a bansonga aba) Nzambi unfuile luse(bis)

hymns.title: TSHIENA NÉ KUAKUNYEMA NZAMBI PANA KUPIDIA WEWE.

versions.title: TSHIENA NÉ KUAKUNYEMA NZAMBI PANA KUPIDIA WEWE.

lines: Tshiena ne ku kunyemaaa, panakupidia wewe Yepowa dibue dianyiii, Yepowa ngabu wanyi (bis)
Nzambi kuye kule to Yepowa kudenkedi to dibue dianyi undameee, unsokoka ne luse, dibue dia tshieyemenu wewe umbuikidila mibi (bis)
Ndi ntenka moyo wanyiii, mu bianza bia Yepowa, nesanka bua Yepowa wanyi, utshidi unkolesha (bis)
Mushimaaa kukanki to udi ne mukusambi ne mukulami muimpe Nzambi ; palua makenga onso (bis)
Nzambi wa Abalahama Nzambi, wa Izaka ne Yakobo dibue dia mu Siyona wewe umbuikidila mibi (bis)

hymns.title: TSHIENA NÉ TSHIEYEMENU PA BULOBA, ANU WEWE NZAMBI WANGI.

versions.title: TSHIENA NÉ TSHIEYEMENU PA BULOBA, ANU WEWE NZAMBI WANGI.

lines: "Tshiena né tshieyemenu pa buloba " "anu wewe Nzambi wangi" (bis)

(Nfumu) Yesu muana wa Nzambi wakalua pa buloba Bua kufuila bantu bandi, ku mutshi munene mutshiamakana "yoyoyo, eyowa dikengaan an an"bis)
Nenu bena buloji, Nudi nudia bantu bandi Nuyikila mutshitungu, Mu luesu Lua makela makela,
Mema yepowa wa misumba, pa ngalua dituku dianyi, Ndituma muanjelu wanyi, Neanusuike ne mionji, Ku bianza ne ku makasa, Ne banuele mu kapia, Ne nudila ne dikenga (bis)

hymns.title: YONE, YONE WAKATUMA BAYIDI BANDI KUDI YESU

versions.title: YONE, YONE WAKATUMA BAYIDI BANDI KUDI YESU

lines: Yone, Yone wakatuma bayidi bandi kudi Yesu, oondayi, ndayi numuebeja ne nyeye mene muntuau musungidi.(bis)
tuenza tshinyi bua kumanya ne ulualua ne mashiya, wewe nyeye ulualua anyi tutekemena nfumu mukuabu.(bis)
Ndayi, ndayi numuambila binuakumona binuakunvua, oompofo, mpofomitabale ne bafue mene bantuabu mbabishibue.(bis)
Yone, Yone kayi udia nekayi unua ne wa demon, oo Yesu, Yesu udia unua ne bantu bamba muntuau mukuatshike.bis
Tuetu, tuetu bantu tudi bu bana mene kudi Yesu, oo bualu katuena ba manya dituku mene dia lua njila wa muoyo.bis

hymns.title: YUDASA ISAKALIYOTA WA MÛ DIKUMI NÉ BABIDI MULUNDA WANGI WEWE MUTUMA KUDI BAKUIDI.

versions.title: YUDASA ISAKALIYOTA WA MÛ DIKUMI NÉ BABIDI MULUNDA WANGI WEWE MUTUMA KUDI BAKUIDI.

lines: Yadasa isakaliota wa mu dikumi ne babidi mulunda wanyi wewe mutuma kudi bakuidi ba Nzambi ne bakulu bua kutua Yesu mishiku tshimanyinu tshia tshitungu (bis)
(tuimbayi alleluia) " Labi moyo labi moyo labi moyo ", Yesu ekuamba Yudasa enza lukasa bualu buebe,(bualu buebe) lekela kutua mitshiku yebe ya tshitungu mulunda wanyi (bis)
Yesu anyi balaba bakasungula Balaba, Balaba ikale ne moyo, bakambila Pilato, manshi a muntu eu Yesu ikala pa mbidi petu ne pa bana betu bonso, Yesu afue watutondo (bis)
Wewe udi kayafa muakuidi munene wa Nzambi mufudi ne mukulu utshiminyina Yesu malu wamonu ne wa kupitshi ne wa mutumu kua Pilato (bis)

hymns.title: YUDASA KUENZA BUALU KUTUNGILA YEZU BUA ANGATA BIUMA AYA KUMPALA KUA BANTU.

versions.title: YUDASA KUENZA BUALU KUTUNGILA YEZU BUA ANGATA BIUMA AYA KUMPALA KUA BANTU.

lines: Yudasa kuenza bualu kutungila Yesu bua angata biuma aya kumpala kua bantu yeye wa kantakakana bualu kakadi ne muaba kudi Nzambi kayi koku kudi bantu kayi muaba " Yudasa wakajowa mala bipatuka munda "
bankunvua Dȋ madilu mu Lama "Lakela udila bua bana ubenga bamusamba mu Lama mudi muadi "nyuma nyuma muimpa nyuma wa badi ne moyo.(bis)
Muana wa muntu Yesu uyaya mua kafundabo bualu bu Yuda kudi bambi mutungidi udi ne mulau bivua bimpa kaledibue, lufu lutonda tatu mushima udi unema " mulau ne dikenga ne bikuata mulenduishi "(bis)

Wewe kuyila Dȋ dikuambila bua kupatuka mu malu, mu bantu ne bintu kuyi unvua ndumba udia uvila wamba ne kakuena bualu lelu eu badi benza malu bamba ne kakuena tshintu " mulau ne dikenga ne bikuata mulenduishi"

hymns.title: ZEKAYI WAKABANDA KU MUTSHI BUA KUMONAYI YESU MUANA WA NZAMBI

versions.title: ZEKAYI WAKABANDA KU MUTSHI BUA KUMONAYI YESU MUANA WA NZAMBI

lines: Zekayi wakabanda ku mutshi; bua kumonayi muana wa Nzambi, Yesu wakamuambila; Zekayo tuluka lupandu ludi kueba lelu(bis)
"(Kadi tatu Zekayo) Tuluka"(x2) Zekayo, lelu lupandu ludi mu nzubu (mu nzubu) mueeebe (bis)
Monayi Bafalese Bafundi ekukongabu Yesu muana wa Nzambi, munyi muntu eu nunku, munyi mut’eu uyaya mu nzubu wa Zekayo(bis)
Ba tatu wanyi bonso ba mamu nudi luseke kayi, ne balunda bua diba ne tshikondo diakumbanyi bananga tuitaba muana wa Nzambi (bis)
